jobs.title: Project Manager - Operations
jobs.description:
About Signant Health

At Signant Health, we help bring life-changing treatments to patients faster. We are a global evidence generation company supporting clinical trials through smart technology, scientific expertise, and hands-on operational support — because better data leads to better healthcare decisions. Our teams work at the intersection of science, technology, and patient experience, delivering digital solutions that make clinical trials more efficient, accurate, and accessible worldwide. Trusted by leading pharmaceutical companies and CROs, our platforms and services support studies in more than 90 countries and have contributed to hundreds of new drug approvals. If you are motivated by meaningful work, global impact, and innovation in clinical research and digital health, you will find purpose — and opportunity — at Signant Health.

About The Role

The Project Manager is responsible for the end-to-end planning, execution, and delivery of projects across Signant Health’s solutions, including Advisory, eCOA, and RTSM. This role ensures alignment with project budgets, timelines, resources, and quality standards while maintaining compliance with regulatory and contractual requirements.
The Project Manager will manage the full software development lifecycle (SDLC), lead cross-functional teams, mitigate risks, and serve as the primary client contact for all project activities. This position requires an experienced, proactive leader who excels at problem-solving, motivates results-oriented teams, and builds strong, trust-based relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

What You Will Do

Manage and lead the successful delivery of multiple, concurrent projects across Advisory, eCOA, and RTSM product lines, ensuring adherence to scope, budget, timelines, and quality.
Oversee the full SDLC from requirements gathering through deployment, ensuring software and solutions are tailored to each client’s specifications.
Apply expertise in project lifecycle management, including:
Budget management and forecasting
Risk identification, mitigation, and assessment
Milestone tracking and reporting
Change management and control
Use project management tools such as Jira, MS Project, Asana, Monday, or Trello to plan, monitor, and track deliverables.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams—Product, Engineering, Quality, and Operations—to ensure compliance with quality and regulatory standards in a highly regulated (Pharma/CRO) environment.
Ensure systems are configured, tested, and deployed in line with client expectations.
Lead client communications, including regular project updates, escalation management, and change discussions.
Handle client escalations independently, collaborating across internal and client teams to resolve issues promptly.
Oversee the financial performance of assigned projects, including vendor management, device procurement, invoicing, and resource allocation.
Support the implementation of complex, multi-product or multi-country projects requiring integration of Advisory, RTSM, and eCOA solutions.
Partner with the Quality Management team to identify, document, and close incident reports in a timely manner.
Provide accurate and transparent project reporting to internal and external stakeholders.

Key Accountabilities – Strategic & Cultural Responsibilities

Promote a culture of continuous improvement, focusing on process efficiency, client value, and operational excellence.
Ensure compliance with internal procedures, client deliverables, and applicable GxP and data protection regulations.
Uphold company values centered on people, clients, and performance.
Contribute to the refinement of project delivery methodologies to improve scalability and consistency across global teams.

Decision-Making and Influence

Lead through influence, guiding cross-functional teams toward shared goals without direct authority.
Assess and manage risks effectively, making informed decisions aligned with company values and client commitments.
Resolve escalations with professionalism, accountability, and transparency.
Communicate proactively and adapt decision-making to evolving project conditions.

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Life Sciences, Project Management, or a related field.
Proven experience managing end-to-end projects in a regulated industry (Pharma, Healthcare, or CRO).
Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and experience adapting technical solutions to meet client needs.
Demonstrated experience in project lifecycle management, including budget oversight, risk management, milestone tracking, and change control.
Hands-on experience with project management tools such as Jira, MS Project, Asana, Monday, or Trello.
Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills with keen attention to detail.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to influence and engage at all organizational levels.
Proven ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and meet tight deadlines in dynamic, fast-paced environments.
Proficiency with MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project).

Desired Qualifications

Background in clinical research, life sciences, or software delivery within a CRO or pharmaceutical environment.
Experience with IRT/RTSM systems, eCOA/ePRO solutions, or Advisory/Consulting engagements.
Knowledge of Good Clinical Practice (GCP), FDA, and other global regulatory requirements.
PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent project management certification.
Strong presentation skills and ability to facilitate discussions across large, cross-functional teams.
Willingness to travel occasionally for client meetings or internal collaboration (typically quarterly).

Why Signant Health?

At Signant Health, your work has real impact. Everything we build, support, and deliver helps advance clinical research and bring new treatments to patients faster — improving lives around the world. Our teams combine science, technology, and operational expertise to solve complex clinical trial challenges, and every role contributes to that mission. We offer a collaborative, global environment where you can grow your career while working alongside experts across clinical, technology, data, and operations, with opportunities to learn, take ownership, and drive meaningful innovation — not just maintain the status quo. If you are looking for purpose-driven work, smart colleagues, and the opportunity to help shape the future of clinical research and digital health, Signant Health is the place to do it.

Language:
Resumes must be submitted in English.

Why Signant Health?

At Signant Health, your work has real impact. Everything we build, support, and deliver helps advance clinical research and bring new treatments to patients faster — improving lives around the world. Our teams combine science, technology, and operational expertise to solve complex clinical trial challenges, and every role contributes to that mission.
We offer a collaborative, global environment where you can grow your career while working alongside experts across clinical, technology, data, and operations, with opportunities to learn, take ownership, and drive meaningful innovation — not just maintain the status quo.
If you are looking for purpose-driven work, smart colleagues, and the opportunity to help shape the future of clinical research and digital health, Signant Health is the place to do it.
At Signant Health, accepting difference isn't enough — we celebrate it, we support it, and we nurture it for the benefit of our team members, our clients, and our community. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer, committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status. Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The Knowledge Systems team builds the infrastructure powering accurate knowledge across customer self-service, internal tools, and AI-assisted support. As Technical Program Manager, you will translate knowledge strategy into technical execution. This is a systems-focused role bridging customer experience, knowledge operations, and technical delivery to build the foundation required to scale support without scaling headcount linearly.

What you’ll do: 

Own technical programs that improve the systems, tooling, and workflows behind customer self-service, internal support knowledge, and AI-assisted discovery (e.g., RAG pipelines, semantic search, and agentic workflows).
Drive cross-functional alignment across Knowledge Systems, engineering, product, and partner teams to translate complex knowledge taxonomies and unstructured data into clear technical specifications, APIs, schemas, and execution plans.
Lead the planning and delivery of high-leverage initiatives such as workflow automation, knowledge system modernization, CMS improvements, metadata and structure enhancements, and launch-readiness tooling.
Partner with Knowledge Systems leads to ensure knowledge is accurate, structured for machine-readability and actionability, ready ahead of launch, and governed appropriately for customer, specialist, and compliance needs.
Build and run an operating cadence for technical initiatives, including roadmap tracking, dependency management, risk escalation, and delivery accountability.
Identify opportunities to reduce manual work, improve scale, and prevent headcount from growing linearly with business complexity and launch volume.

Required skills and experience:

5+ years of technical program management, systems implementation, or operational program leadership in a complex cross-functional environment.
Deep familiarity with modern information retrieval architectures (such as vector databases, RAG, and LLM orchestration tools like LangChain or LlamaIndex) alongside CMS platforms, structured content, and metadata models.
Strong systems thinking and operational judgment, with the ability to connect technical decisions to customer impact, specialist usability, compliance risk, and business performance.
Experience translating operational strategy into technical requirements, data schemas, and tooling investments.
Strong understanding of content systems, knowledge management, workflow automation, and internal tooling in operations or CX environments.
Proven ability to drive alignment across technical and non-technical stakeholders, especially where ownership is distributed and tradeoffs must be actively managed.
Demonstrated experience leading ambiguous, multi-team initiatives from concept through launch with clear accountability, risk management, and measurable outcomes.
Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality

Program & Project Leadership

- Lead the enterprise Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) rollout across Engineering, coordinating data migration, process redesign, and user adoption

- Coordinate testing, training, communication, and business readiness activities to support adoption and value realization

Continuous Improvement

- Identify opportunities to improve delivery effectiveness and operational performance
- Promote best practices in project management, process improvement, and organizational change
Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in Business, Technology, Engineering, or related field

- 5+ years of project or program management experience leading enterprise initiatives

- Demonstrated success delivering cross-functional business and technology transformations

- Strong leadership, communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills

- Experience managing scope, schedule, resources, risks, and dependencies

- Proven track record executing full implementation lifecycles (discovery through hypercare)

- Experience managing software and process changes across all phases of an agile or iterative lifecycle

- Experience implementing or supporting enterprise PLM, CPQ, or ERP Platforms

- Ability to work in fast-paced environments, managing multiple priorities and stakeholders

Preferred

Position Overview

As a Project Manager, you'll lead and manage commercial HVAC projects from preconstruction through closeout, coordinating field teams, subcontractors, vendors, and clients to deliver on-time, on-budget results with exceptional safety, quality, and customer satisfaction. Working closely with operations leadership, you'll proactively identify risks/opportunities, track budgets, foster open communication, and drive profitability while building long-term relationships. Our people-first culture empowers your leadership with professional development, mentorship, cross-functional collaboration, and the opportunity to mentor teams in delivering sustainable, efficient mechanical systems nationwide at any of our operating companies.

Duties And Responsibilities

Manage full project lifecycle: planning, scheduling, budgeting, resource allocation, risk management, change orders, and closeout for HVAC/mechanical projects.
Review bid documents, drawings, and scopes early to identify potential issues, opportunities, risks, omissions, and value engineering possibilities; develop workable solutions to prevent problems.
Collaborate with preconstruction, estimating, and operations teams to create realistic schedules, budgets, and project plans that meet milestones and financial targets.
Track project budgets, costs, labor productivity, variances, and forecasts; identify shortcomings/pitfalls or profit-enhancing opportunities and implement corrective actions.
Promote open communication among project teams, clients, architects, engineers, subcontractors, and internal departments to resolve conflicts and ensure alignment.
Organize and lead coordination meetings, site walks, and progress reviews; maintain detailed documentation of scope changes, execution decisions, costs, and client communications.
Ensure strict adherence to contract documents, specifications, company policies, safety requirements, quality expectations, and ethical standards.
Champion quality assurance: conduct job-site reviews, ensure installations meet/exceed industry standards, prevent call-backs/warranty issues, and partner with quality teams on processes/inspections.
Build and maintain long-term relationships with clients, architects, engineers, general contractors, subcontractors, and vendors to support repeat business and future opportunities.
Recruit, train, mentor, and develop project team members; track performance, delegate appropriately, nominate for promotions/incentives, and participate in hiring as needed.
Enforce safety compliance across teams: assure PPE usage, coordinate with safety officers for inspections/visits, and uphold company/project safety protocols at all times.
Provide leadership vision for project planning, coordination, sequencing, labor utilization, and continuous improvement; communicate updates and issues to executive leadership.

Supervisory Responsibilities

Yes – Direct supervision and leadership of superintendents, foremen, field personnel, and support staff on assigned projects; responsible for performance evaluations, training/mentoring, promotions/incentives, conflict resolution, and team development to ensure high performance, safety adherence, and project success.

Requirements/Qualifications

Experience: 5–10+ years of progressive project management experience in commercial HVAC/mechanical construction or related building services; proven track record managing teams and projects valued from $500K to multi-million dollars.
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Mechanical Engineering, or related field preferred; equivalent experience with strong technical HVAC knowledge considered.
Certifications: PMP, LEED, OSHA 30-hour, or relevant trade certifications a plus; valid driver's license and clean driving record required.
Physical Demands: Primarily office-based with frequent job-site visits; ability to walk active construction sites, climb ladders/stairs, lift light materials (plans, laptop), and travel regionally/nationally as needed; standard office mobility for computer work and meetings.
Work Environment/Safety: Professional office with hybrid options and active construction sites; exposure to varying weather, noise, dust, heights; must adhere to OSHA regulations, conduct hazard identification, and wear required PPE (hard hat, safety glasses, steel-toed boots) on sites—safety is our top priority and non-negotiable. This is a safety-sensitive position.

Required Skills

Advanced project management (scheduling, budgeting, risk management, change order negotiation, cost control).
Strong leadership, team mentoring, performance management, and conflict resolution.
Proficiency with project tools (Procore, MS Project, Bluebeam, Excel) and financial tracking.
Excellent written/verbal communication, client/stakeholder management, and relationship building.
Safety and quality leadership; ability to read/interpret contracts, blueprints, specs, and scopes.
Multitasking under pressure, initiative, professionalism, and commitment to ethics/compliance.

Modigent is a national leader delivering next-generation infrastructure, technology, and energy solutions through our family of specialized brands in HVAC, plumbing, and controls systems. With a strong coast-to-coast presence and extensive service capabilities, we empower customers, communities, and our over 1,500 team members to thrive with sustainable, efficient commercial building services. As part of our team, you'll contribute to thoughtful innovation and our people-first culture rooted in service, collaboration, and integrity.

Comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus HSA options with employer contributions in select plans, and company-paid basic life and accidental death & dismemberment insurance.

No benefits

Responsibilities

Lead Taiwan-based early-stage design and engineering programs with ODM/CM and Microsoft engineering partners, translating program priorities into aligned outcomes and effective local execution.

Establish joint delivery accountability with ODM/CM engineering partners, aligning commitments, dependencies, and expectations to improve quality and delivery predictability.
Connect Taiwan, US, and global labs through two-way sharing of engineering expertise, best practices, resources, and capabilities. Promote reuse and reduce time-zone and remote-management friction.
Lead cross-organizational resolution of program risks, dependencies, and decisions in partnership with existing engineering and operational owners. Clarify tradeoffs and drive issues to closure without duplicating technical ownership.
Use program evidence and partner feedback to identify improvements in local engineering execution and lab collaboration. Scale practices that strengthen readiness, quality, resource effectiveness, and business outcomes.
Communicate program health, priorities, risks, and recommendations to stakeholders. Build alignment on decisions and resource tradeoffs across Taiwan partners and global engineering leadership.
Shape Taiwan lab and engineering partner collaboration strategy with engineering, sourcing, and operations leaders. Align partner capabilities with evolving program needs while respecting established commercial and operational ownership.

Bachelor's Degree AND 6+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development OR equivalent experience.
5+ years of experience leading cross-functional programs across engineering, operations, hardware, infrastructure, manufacturing, lab, or supply chain environments.
Experience establishing operating mechanisms that align program priorities, ownership, dependencies, and delivery commitments across teams.
Experience influencing senior stakeholders and driving alignment across teams without direct authority.

Strong analytical skills and experience using data to assess program health, inform resource tradeoffs, and improve quality and delivery predictability.

Strong written and verbal communication skills in English and Mandarin Chinese, with the ability to engage local engineering partners and global stakeholders.
Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements is required for this role, including Microsoft Cloud Background Check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

jobs.title: Program Manager III, Strategic Initiatives Team
jobs.description:
Description

The NAMER Cloud Sales Center (CSC) is AGS's primary scale revenue engine and its most important talent developer, delivering $4B in revenue and ambitious annual growth. Early career talent sits at the heart of that engine: these sellers feed up to 60% of Field sellers and contribute an outsized share of CSC pipeline. This role owns the front door to that system.

As Senior Program Manager for Early Career Talent & Employer Brand, you own how CSC attracts, selects, and launches the next generation of sellers, and how the market sees CSC as the place to start a career in cloud sales. You will own the internship program, the co-op program, and the broader early-career strategy that shapes the caliber, diversity, engagement, and readiness of everyone who enters AGS through this door. This is a role that is strategic and tactical in equal measure: you will set multi-year strategy while running live cohorts that deliver measurable, in-year business impact.

You will join a team of senior program leaders in the CSC Strategic Initiatives Team, each owning a connected part of the talent flywheel — enablement, talent strategy and matriculation, platforms and data, and partner activation. You own the top of that flywheel and the employer brand that fills it. Success looks like a high-caliber, diverse, engaged early-career pipeline that converts faster, ramps faster, and strengthens CSC's competitive position for the next generation of GenAI-native sellers.

Key job responsibilities

Own the early-career talent portfolio end to end: Connect the internship program, co-op program, and strategy into a single entry-point to the CSC’s integrated talent engine
Own CSC's early-career employer brand and talent profile: Define who we attract and how we are seen, while treating the caliber, diversity, and engagement of incoming talent as a strategic lever
Set strategy and run execution: Design the multi-year early-career model while owning live cohorts and their in-year pipeline and conversion outcomes
Feed the talent flywheel: Partner with leadership on matriculation timing and workforce-planning inputs so early-career talent flows predictably into onboarding, development, and Field roles
Set and hold the intake quality bar: Ensure new talent is prepared for full-time roles, accelerating time to productivity and increasing impact
Prove impact with data: Collaborate with data teams to instrument early-career conversion, ramp, and diversity metrics to clearly articulate ROI
Amplify through partners: Connect employer-brand moments and early-career events into the broader partner activation strategy so they reinforce the wider engine
Operate with executive visibility: Represent early-career talent as a named pillar of the org's talent strategy, with regular exposure to senior leadership and Field partners

A day in the life

You start the morning reviewing conversion and pipeline data from the current cohort with the data team, then join a working session with talent-strategy leadership on matriculation timing for the next intake. Before lunch you are refining the co-op model and the employer-brand plan for the next campus season. In the afternoon you sync with enablement on the intake quality bar, align an upcoming early-career event with the partner team, and close the day preparing a readout for senior leadership on the two things that matter most this quarter.

About The Team

Our team is focused on delivering programs that have broad impact across Amazon. We work collaboratively with leaders across AWS to solve problems at scale. We value clear thinking, thoughtful communication, and a willingness to challenge assumptions in pursuit of the best outcomes. As we continue to grow, we are building an inclusive team culture where every voice matters and where program managers have the opportunity to shape strategy and drive results that customers feel directly.

About AWS

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector. The AWS Global Support team interacts with leading companies and believes that world-class support is critical to customer success. AWS Support also partners with a global list of customers that are building mission-critical applications on top of AWS services.

Basic Qualifications

5+ years of program or project management experience
Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

Preferred Qualifications

4+ years of driving process improvements experience
Knowledge of general AI tools
Experience designing, implementing, and scaling upskilling, apprenticeship, or workforce development programs across large-scale operations or corporate environments, including forecasting workforce needs and leveraging analytics to drive program decisions

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits.

jobs.description:

Description

CPH is a multi-disciplinary Engineering and Architecture firm that ranks in the nation’s Top 500 Design Firms by ENR Magazine. We are seeking a Senior Program Manager to join and help lead our dynamic team in Sanford, FL
!

The Senior Program Manager is responsible for leading strategic commercial development programs from business development through successful project delivery and client relationship growth. This role combines program leadership, business development, financial accountability, and team development to build profitable, sustainable client programs across Retail, Mixed-Use, Industrial, and other private development markets.

Working closely with executive leadership, the Senior Program Manager will strengthen key client relationships, identify new business opportunities, expand multidisciplinary services, and lead high-performing teams in delivering complex commercial site/civil development programs throughout Florida and the Southeast.

Duties Include

Client Development & Business Growth
Represent CPH professionally, developing and strengthening long-term relationships with strategic commercial clients, developers, owners, consultants, and industry partners.
Identify opportunities to expand CPH's Architecture, Structural Engineering, MEP, Civil Engineering, Surveying, and other multidisciplinary services.
Lead business development activities and support strategic market expansion throughout Florida and the Southeast.
Identify, pursue, and convert new opportunities aligned with CPH's strategic growth objectives.
Prepare proposals, scopes of work, project strategies, schedules, staffing plans, and fee estimates.
Participate in client presentations, interviews, negotiations, and professional services agreement development.
Partner with executive leadership to develop and execute strategic account and market growth plans.

Program & Project Leadership
Lead multidisciplinary teams delivering complex commercial building development programs.
Provide overall leadership and accountability for project planning, execution, and client communication.
Maintain accountability for program scope, schedule, budget, staffing, quality, risk, and client satisfaction.
Coordinate resources across Architecture, Structural Engineering, MEP, Civil Engineering, Surveying, and other disciplines to ensure efficient and profitable project delivery.
Establish program priorities, delivery strategies, milestones, and performance expectations.
Proactively identify and address project risks, scope changes, resource constraints, and client concerns.
Ensure projects are delivered in accordance with CPH standards, contractual requirements, and client expectations.
Promote consistent project management practices and operational excellence across assigned programs.

Business Unit Leadership
Serve as a strategic partner to the Senior Vice President and Business Unit leadership team.
Support business planning, resource forecasting, staffing strategies, and long-term program development.
Identify opportunities to improve operational performance, delivery processes, and profitability.
Support the development and implementation of Business Unit growth strategies.
Contribute to market intelligence, competitive analysis, and identification of emerging opportunities.
Help establish repeatable processes and delivery models that support scalable program growth.
Promote accountability, collaboration, innovation, continuous improvement, client service, and profitable growth.

Team Leadership & Development
Lead, mentor, and develop project managers, engineers, technical professionals, and other team members.
Build high-performing multidisciplinary teams aligned with program requirements and client expectations.
Establish clear roles, responsibilities, performance expectations, and accountability.
Support succession planning and development of future program and project leaders.
Provide coaching and feedback to strengthen technical, project management, business development, and leadership capabilities.
Foster a collaborative environment across Civil, Surveying, Landscape Architecture, Architecture, and other disciplines.

Financial & Operational Accountability
Maintain accountability for program financial performance and profitability.
Develop and monitor project and program budgets, forecasts, staffing plans, and resource requirements.
Evaluate project performance and implement corrective actions when necessary.
Manage scope, change orders, contractual requirements, and fee utilization.
Support accurate revenue forecasting, backlog management, and invoicing.
Ensure project teams maintain appropriate documentation and follow established CPH financial and operational procedures.

Requirements

Education and Experience:

Required
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, Business, or a related discipline.
Minimum of 10 years of progressive experience in A/E consulting, engineering, construction, commercial development, or a related professional services environment.
Demonstrated experience leading complex commercial development programs and multidisciplinary teams.
Proven experience developing and managing strategic client relationships.
Demonstrated experience with proposals, scope development, fee development, budgeting, scheduling, staffing, and contract negotiations.
Demonstrated experience managing financial performance and profitability of projects or programs.
Experience leading and developing teams of technical professionals.

Preferred
Professional Engineering (PE) license, professional registration, technical certification, or equivalent industry experience.
PMP certification, MBA, or other advanced business or project management credential.
Experience supporting national or regional commercial clients.
Experience within Retail, Mixed-Use, Industrial, Healthcare, Education, Assisted Living, Facilities, or other private development markets.
Experience managing programs or teams of approximately 10 or more professionals.
Established network of commercial developers, owners, consultants, or industry partners.
Experience supporting market expansion across Florida or the Southeast.

Compensation & Benefits

Dependent upon experience.
CPH offers Medical, Dental and Vision and Long-Term Disability with a quality insurance company.
Company Paid Life Insurance and Short-Term Disability.
401K, Paid Personal Time Off, Paid Holidays, and Paid Paternal Leave.

jobs.description:
It’s exhilarating to find yourself at a pivotal moment in history— and even more so to be leading the way. At QTS Data Centers, we are proud to stand at the forefront of today’s dynamic digital transformation. Our world-class data centers empower our customers’ most strategic growth initiatives, positioning us as a global leader in digital infrastructure.

As AI and cloud technologies fuel the demand for increased speed, capacity, and innovation, QTS has emerged as the global digital infrastructure leader. We are committed to connecting the globe for good. Driven by purpose and a spirit of innovation, we design, build, and operate some of the most advanced data centers worldwide. In addition to our cutting-edge technology, we are dedicated to sustainability, incorporating renewable energy solutions to minimize our environmental footprint and drive meaningful impact. As a proud portfolio company of Blackstone, QTS is uniquely positioned to achieve ambitious growth and innovation goals.

At QTS, we are Powered by People. Our team members are the cornerstone of our culture, innovation, and growth. They are mission-driven, resourceful, and committed to making a positive impact in the communities where we live and work. Together, we’re achieving remarkable things and shaping the future of digital infrastructure.

And we’d like to invite you to join us.

Roth and Traditional 401(k) matching contributions with immediate vesting

Who We Are

As a global leader in digital infrastructure, QTS designs, builds and operates advanced data centers that support strategic AI, cloud and digital transformation initiatives. We are driven by a mission to connect the world for good and our people make it possible. Every single day, the creativity, dedication and genuine care for our communities are what push us forward and make this a truly special place to be.

The Utility Development Program Manager
will support the overall planning and execution of QTS utility infrastructure. This role will support the delivery of utility capacity at multiple campuses across the North American region for data center substation, transmission line (TL), and utility build projects. This role will interface and collaborate with many critical stakeholders, including but not limited to energy leaders responsible for utility contracts and negotiations; utility engagement developing relationships with utilities and transmission providers; pre-development leads evaluating new properties; operations leaders managing load growth projections; and development team project leaders planning and building new data centers.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES -
Other duties may be assigned.

Create and implement a strategy to ensure timely delivery of power delivery to development sites as needed to support existing and future leases
Serve on the diligence team to advise and evaluate utility capacity feasibility of potential new sites, including transmission line routing, interconnection, and deliverability constraints
Management of partners and consultants related to electrical substation and transmission line design and construction
Lead in standardization of utility substation design, including distribution feeds to multiple buildings
Coordinate transmission line development activities, including route selection, right-of-way (ROW) acquisition support, permitting, and easement strategy in partnership with utilities and third-party engineers
Support transmission interconnection processes, including coordination with utilities, ISOs/RTOs, and regulatory bodies to secure timely energization
Manage budgets and cost forecasting of utility projects, including construction and equipment for both substation and transmission line scopes
Develop transformer, transmission structure, and equipment specifications
Procure substation long lead equipment, transmission line materials (conductor, structures, insulators), and transformers
Procure and manage the construction of multiple substation and transmission line sites simultaneously
Track and report on the status and schedule of power delivery timelines, including transmission line milestones and interconnection dependencies
Support natural gas utility development activities, including coordination with gas providers, pipeline routing, service agreements, permitting, easements, and schedule alignment with campus power delivery needs

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, construction, or equivalent experience
7+ years of medium/high-voltage substation, transmission line, or utility infrastructure construction management experience
Demonstrated experience leading complex utility or infrastructure projects
Working knowledge of transmission line design, construction, interconnection, and natural gas utility processes
Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including PowerPoint for executive reporting and Excel for budgets and tracking
Ability to travel up to 50%

Preferred Qualifications

10+ years of electrical substation, transmission line, or utility infrastructure construction experience
Strong industry knowledge of utility partners, transformer manufacturers, transmission contractors, and material suppliers
Technical expertise in high- and medium-voltage electrical design or construction, including overhead and underground transmission systems
Experience with transmission permitting, ROW acquisition, regulatory/ISO interconnection, and natural gas utility coordination
Experience managing large portfolios of utility or infrastructure work

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

Strong verbal and written communication skills
Ability to be flexible and adapt to changing situations at a high growth company
Ability to build strong internal and external working relationships with utilities, transmission providers, and regulatory agencies
Ability to coordinate across electric and gas utilities to align infrastructure delivery, permitting, easement, and service requirements
Ability to prioritize, multitask, and deliver high quality work in tight timeframes

Transmission (Overhead & Underground)
Transmission Interconnection / ROW & Permitting
High-voltage electricity
Utilities
Natural Gas Utilities

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Standardization
jobs.description:
Build the future, spark innovation and align your career with purpose.

McKinstry is innovating the waste and climate harm out of the built environment and creating lasting impact. Together, we’re building a thriving planet.

Buildings are a leading contributor to the climate crisis, generating nearly 40% of total global energy-related carbon emissions. We’re making a lasting impact on our industry and within our communities by addressing the climate, affordability and equity crises through:

renewables and energy services
engineering and design
construction and facility services

To get where we’re going, we need big thinkers, problem solvers and collaborative mindsets. Does that sound like you?

The Opportunity with McKinstry

McKinstry is looking for a Senior Program Manager, Standardization to join our Offsite Manufacturing division in Spokane, WA. The Senior Program Manager – Standardization leads the development, release, and adoption of the business processes that run the business unit and leads execution of the department's technology and business process improvement initiatives. The role's current top priority is leading implementation of Acumatica, the business unit's ERP system — building and maintaining the implementation schedule, providing status updates, and documenting the business process decisions made along the way — with the same playbook applied to future technology and process initiatives. Beyond named initiatives, the role focuses on business unit processes, especially those that cross functional boundaries where commercial, engineering, supply chain, operations, quality, project management, and finance must hand off work to one another. This role shapes how the business executes and drives development of documented, governed, repeatable standard work. Additional responsibilities may include:

Business Process Leadership

Own the process roadmap for the business unit, sequencing standardization work against live production commitments, growth targets, and customer program milestones.
Maintain the business unit’s process architecture: what processes exist, who owns each, how they connect, and where the gaps are.
Translate business objectives into standardization objectives and measures with leadership and report progress regularly.
Advise leaders on where standardization creates leverage and where flexibility should be intentionally preserved.
Initiative and Implementation Management
Lead the implementation of Acumatica (ERP), including building and maintaining the implementation schedule and providing regular status updates.
Apply the same implementation approach — schedule ownership, decision documentation, stakeholder alignment — to future technology and process improvement initiatives.
Organize and execute department business process improvement initiatives from scoping through completion.
Draft and propose OKRs for initiatives or execute against and report progress on OKRs set by leadership, depending on the initiative.
Source, select, and manage contractors and consultants supporting initiatives, owning scope, schedule, and budget for those engagements.

Cross-Functional Process Integration

Lead standardization of processes that span multiple functions, including order intake and contract-to-production handoff, engineering release and change control, procurement and long-lead material planning, production scheduling and capacity, quality and nonconformance, shipping and field integration, and warranty and closeout.
Define the inputs, outputs, ownership, and acceptance criteria at each functional handoff so work does not stall or degrade in the gaps between teams.
Resolve conflicting or duplicative practice between functions, escalating to leadership where process ownership is genuinely contested.
Embed processes into the systems of record – ERP, document control, quality management, and reporting – so process is reinforced by tooling rather than carried by individual experience.
Reconcile customer-specific commercial requirements with internal standard work so program obligations are met without one-off process.

Process Development and Release

Coordinate cross-functional teams through a standard development process to produce released, version-controlled deliverables.
Write and review policies, procedures, work instructions, and supporting documentation — including documenting the business process decisions made during initiative implementations — with process owners and subject matter experts.
Establish document control, revision, and approval conventions so processes are governed.

Change Management, Training, and Adoption

Develop implementation plans supporting communication, training, and sustained adoption of process deliverables.
Train project teams and operational leaders on the standard development process.
Communicate initiatives in small and large group settings, developing materials calibrated to mixed executive, commercial, engineering, operations, and craft audiences.

Team Leadership and Performance

Build process capability inside functional teams so ownership sits with the business, not solely with the program.
Track measures of process health: adoption and conformance, cycle time, rework and escape rates, audit findings, and other metrics as appropriate.
Route lessons learned back into the applicable processes.
No direct reports Day 1; may take on direct personnel management responsibility as the team grows.

Other duties as assigned.

What You Need To Succeed At McKinstry

Bachelor’s Degree required (industrial, mechanical, or manufacturing engineering, operations management, or supply chain preferred).
Minimum eight (8) years of team and/or project management experience required.
Demonstrated experience developing and deploying business process, standard work, or a quality management system across multiple functions in a manufacturing, industrialized construction, or offsite fabrication environment required.
Demonstrated ability to collaborate with and influence people at all levels across the organization required.
Excellent facilitation skills and the ability to lead diverse, cross-functional project teams required.
Ability to operate effectively in a high-growth environment where process and governance are authored in parallel with live production commitments.
Demonstrated experience managing scope, schedule, and budget for contractor or consulting engagements required.
Strongly Preferred: technical writing; engineer-to-order or high-mix production experience; ERP implementation experience (Acumatica preferred),, PLM, or document control systems; PMI certification; ISO 9001 or equivalent quality management system; LEAN Construction.

PeopleFirst Benefits

When it comes to the basics, we have you covered:

Competitive pay
401(k) with employer match and profit-sharing plan
Paid time off and holidays
Comprehensive medical, prescription, dental, and vision with low or zero deductible options and low out of pocket maximums

People come first at McKinstry, and we go beyond the basic benefits with:

Family formation benefits, including adoption and IVF assistance
Up to 16 weeks paid parental leave
Transgender inclusive benefits
Commuter benefits
Pet insurance
“Building Good” paid community service time
Learning and advancement opportunities via McKinstry University
McKinstry Moves onsite gyms or reimbursement for remote workers

See benefit plan documents for complete details.

If you’re driven by our vision to build a thriving planet together, McKinstry is the place to build your career.

Experience with structured product development processes, including phase-gate development methodologies and manufacturing transfer readiness.

Master’s degree in aerospace engineering.

Fluency in English and German.
Strong oral and written communication skills

Positive and flexible attitude to get the job done

Demonstrates behaviours consistent with The Exploration Company’s core values of Mission, Vision, Integrity, Excellence and Teamwork
Space enthusiast: ready to change the global space industry

We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them

offers experiential learning and flexibility, allowing you to balance your personal life and career goals.

working for Siemens.

Freedom and a healthy work- life balance– Embrace our flexible work environment with flex hours, telecommuting and digital workspaces.

Engaging, challenging, and fast evolving, cutting edge technological environment.

Opportunities to contribute your innovative ideas and get paid for them!
Diversity and inclusivity focused.

Siemens is proud to be an eight-time award winner of Canada’s Top 100 Employers, Canada’s Greenest Employers 2026 and Canada’s Top Employers for Young People 2026.

What will you do?

The New Product Introduction process drives the successful development and launches of new products through a structured, stage-gate approach - from initial concept to full-scale production and market release. The role requires balancing multiple concurrent projects at different stages of the product lifecycle, from concept development through production release and sustaining activities. As the NPI project manager you will work closely with teams across R&D engineering (HW and SW) , product management, Production and Test engineering, manufacturing, quality, procurement, suppliers, and other key stakeholders.

Parallel to new development, the NPI group also sustains legacy products, monitoring component changes, implementing engineering updates, and collaborating with quality to address issues and maintain reliability over the long term.

Throughout the entire NPI lifecycle, clear communication, data-driven decisions, and a commitment to continuous improvement are critical to successfully bringing innovative products to market and maintaining a competitive edge. Within the NPI team, you will have the opportunity to work on all business-related projects relating to Manufacturing. This includes managing production line transfers between factories, quality initiatives and improvement projects.

Responsibilities:

Project Ownership & Lifecycle Management

Take ownership of assigned projects from initial concept through to full-scale production, ensuring every milestone in our structured stage-gate process is met with precision.
Play a pivotal role in our growth by coordinating the systematic transfer of production lines to our state-of-the-art new facility, ensuring a smooth "handshake" between sites.
Manage multiple projects simultaneously while balancing scope, schedule, resources, and stakeholder expectations.
Identify project risks, dependencies, and roadblocks early and drive mitigation actions to maintain project schedules.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Communication

Lead cross-functional workshops and meetings with engineering, quality, and logistics teams to ensure the receiving factory is fully prepared for incoming new products and production lines.
Keep leadership informed through clear, concise updates on project status, proactively identifying risks and proposing creative solutions to keep us on track.
Coordinate activities between Siemens factories, contract manufacturers, suppliers, and R&D teams to support product launches, product transfers, and engineering changes.

Technical Execution & Operational Readiness

Oversee the technical details of line transfers, including equipment re-commissioning, process validation, and ensure the floor is "ready to run" on day one.
Manage the NPI build schedule by aligning material requirements and assembly needs across Product Management, Engineering, Contract Manufacturing and other Siemens facilities.

Continuous Improvement & Strategy

Bring a fresh perspective to our workflows by identifying opportunities to improve our project management tools and new product development.
Evaluate project trade-offs—balancing scope, schedule, and resources—to make data-driven recommendations that protect the project’s success.
Support engineering change implementation and product sustaining activities to ensure long-term manufacturability and reliability.
You will be supported by senior mentors and a structured onboarding program to help you transition from university theory to world-class manufacturing execution

What will you need to succeed?

Recent university graduate (within 12 months) in Engineering programs with a minimum 2.5 GPA (B-)). Transcripts to be provided upon request.
Strong verbal and written skills with the ability to collaborate across diverse, cross-functional teams.
Proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint; ability to translate data into clear presentations.
Exposure to project management and collaboration tools such as Azure DevOps, Microsoft Planner, Microsoft Project, SharePoint, Concept board, or similar tools is considered an asset.
Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing or process optimization is a strong asset
Completion of at least one co-op term; familiarity with Lean Manufacturing or New Product Introduction (NPI).
Ability to work in a hybrid environment and be present on-site in Concord, ON as required to support project and manufacturing activities. Travel domestically and internationally as required.
A proactive learner with a growth mindset and a passion for manufacturing innovation.

Hourly is commensurate with experience, and ranges between $ 33 CAD - $ 44 CAD.

We share our ideas and champion the people behind them.

Siemens Canada is a leading technology company focused on industry, infrastructure, mobility and healthcare. The company’s purpose is to create technology with purpose, transforming the everyday, for everyone, since 1912 in Canada. A leader in industrial AI, Siemens leverages its deep domain know-how to apply AI – including generative AI – to real-world applications, making AI accessible and impactful for customers across diverse industries. Sustainably. In fiscal 2025, which ended September 30, 2025, Siemens Canada generated revenues of approx. $2.3 billion CAD. The company has approximately 4,600 employees from coast-to-coast and 38 office and production facilities across Canada.

jobs.description:
Description

Are you passionate about safety and ready to drive meaningful change at a global scale? Join our team as a Workplace, Health, and Safety (WHS) Program Manager and play a pivotal role in protecting the people who power Amazon's worldwide operations.

In this role, you'll serve as a trusted safety partner to senior regional and regional leaders, ensuring world-class safety standards for Information Technology (IT) team members across Amazon's global network. Through regular site visits, you'll stay closely connected to the daily realities of our frontline technicians — translating those insights into impactful regional and global safety programs.

You will own and drive safety programs from inception through implementation, lead rigorous incident investigations to uncover root causes, and develop corrective actions that prevent recurrence. You'll also design and execute safety campaigns that embed a culture of ownership and accountability across the business.

Collaborating cross-functionally with Operations, Engineering, HR, and beyond, you'll scale successful safety initiatives and help cement Amazon's reputation as an industry safety leader.

Key job responsibilities

Own and drive safety programs from inception through global implementation, delivering measurable risk reduction outcomes across Amazon's worldwide network
Lead and manage safety-related projects end-to-end, defining clear actions, owners, and timelines to ensure successful delivery
Author narrative papers and business reviews for senior leadership audiences, clearly communicating safety priorities, program performance, and investment recommendations
Solve complex safety challenges faced by IT employees, including work at heights, hazardous energy, and battery safety, developing scalable solutions that reduce risk across the organization
Serve as a trusted safety partner to regional leaders, aligning on strategic priorities and tracking progress against goals
Conduct regular site visits to distribution centers, sortation facilities, and delivery stations to personally observe safety practices, gather frontline feedback, and identify opportunities for improvement
Develop and update regional and global safety standards, protocols, and training materials informed by site visit insights, driving consistent, best-in-class safety performance
Lead comprehensive incident investigations, rapidly identifying root causes and implementing corrective actions to prevent recurrence and share learnings globally
Collaborate cross-functionally with teams in Operations, Engineering, HR, and beyond to scale successful safety initiatives and embed sustainable improvements
Monitor safety metrics, analyze trends, and present data-driven recommendations to senior leadership on priorities and investment areas

A day in the life

Your day might begin with check-in calls with regional leaders across Europe to discuss emerging issues and align on priorities. You'll then join a global project call to review a battery end-of-life management narrative with teammates worldwide. In the afternoon, you lead an incident investigation — reviewing footage, interviewing witnesses, and mapping root causes. You may also partner with field leaders on action plans, design safety features for new equipment, or close the day analyzing a global safety dashboard to prepare data-driven recommendations for senior leadership.

About The Team

The global WHS OpsTech Solutions team partners closely with Amazon's IT function, working to identify safety improvement opportunities by staying closely connected to the daily realities of our frontline technicians and end users. We collaborate cross-functionally to create policies, drive standardization, and enhance hardware — all with the goal of continuously improving procedural safety across the organization. By remaining grounded in the experiences of our workforce, we develop targeted solutions that protect our people and empower them to work safely. It's a dynamic, solutions-oriented group where we leverage our technical expertise and business acumen to make a real impact.

Experience using data and metrics to measure impact and determine improvements
Experience in program or project management
Experience in written and spoken English and an ability to compose grammatically correct, concise and accurate written responses
Experience in safety and/or environmental programs in manufacturing, production, service operations, or related fields
Bachelors degree, or equivalent, in engineering, safety, environmental, or equivalent field of study
NEBOSH, IOSH, CHMM, ASP, CSP, or CIH certification
Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) Fluency

Preferred Qualifications

Knowledge of SQL at an intermediate level, including: compile queries, subqueries, aggregation/grouping, data modification, etc.
Experience in a fast paced, dynamic organization
Experience working within a global company, with multi-country responsibilities
Knowledge of Excel at an intermediate level (e.g., pivot tables & charts, multiple criteria lookups, nested logical/IF formulas, data cleansing, array formulas, etc.)
Experience managing projects and working independently
Experience in technical writing in a relevant field
Experience supporting or working in IT, IT Equipment, Data Centers, or related fields.

jobs.title: Operations Research Analyst, Mission Engineering
jobs.description:
CHAOS Industries is redefining modern defense with a multi-product portfolio that gives the ultimate advantage—domain dominance. The company's products are powered by Coherent Distributed Networks (CDN™), empowering warfighters, commercial air operators, and border protection teams to act faster, adapt rapidly, and stay ahead of evolving threats.

CHAOS Industries was founded in 2022 and has raised a total of $1 billion in funding from leading investors, including 8VC, Accel, and Valor Equity Partners. The company is headquartered in Los Angeles, with offices in Washington, D.C., San Francisco, San Diego, Seattle, and London. For more information, please visit www.chaosinc.com.

About the Team:
Mission Engineering at CHAOS turns simulation output into decisions. We run large-scale modeling and simulation campaigns across all warfighting domains and the full kill chain, against named threats, in operationally relevant scenarios, at the speed engineering, operational, and customer teams actually need. Every CHAOS engineering trade, pursuit, and customer engagement is anchored in rigorous, physics-based, tactically relevant, and statistically valid analysis, and we're scaling the function to meet that bar across a growing product portfolio.

About the Role:
On the Mission Engineering team at CHAOS, you will design, develop, execute, analyze, and validate models and simulations to deliver operational analysis and system performance assessment across defense, national security, and commercial programs. You will have freedom to move rapidly and use your expertise to apply rigorous statistical methods to analyze simulation outcomes, quantify system effectiveness, and communicate actionable insights to technical teams, leadership, and customers. Your work will directly inform critical decisions around sensor performance, mission planning, weapon effectiveness, and platform capability evaluation.

This is a foundational hire. You will shape how CHAOS does mission analysis from day one, and you will have the freedom to move fast.

What You'll Do

Scope, plan, and execute modeling and simulation efforts and studies aligned to program objectives, managing your competing priorities and timelines effectively.
Develop, configure, and execute analysis using mission-level models and simulations such as AFSIM, ESAMS, Brawler, Ansys STK, and/or physics-based models to evaluate system and platform performance in operationally relevant scenarios.
Build and refine models of sensors, communications systems, aircraft (including unmanned), weapons, and spacecraft within mission-level simulation frameworks.
Architect, implement, and validate models of both blue and red systems, sensors, communications, weapons, aircraft, spacecraft, and ground/maritime platforms, within mission- and engagement-level simulation frameworks.
Define and apply rigorous statistical methodologies to simulation results to quantify measures of effectiveness and performance to produce relevant and defensible findings for internal and external stakeholders.
Develop and maintain Python-based analysis tools and pipelines for data processing, statistical analysis, and visualization.
Implement technical methodology, simulation best practices, and customer engagement.
Document methodology, assumptions, and findings in technical reports and briefing materials, including data visualizations, and present results to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Partner with engineering, product, growth, and customer teams to translate operational questions into well-structured analytical approaches and shape new business pursuits. Push back when the framing is wrong.

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Aerospace/Software/Computer Engineering, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Operations Research, Physics, or a related field.
5+ years of experience supporting defense, intelligence, or advanced technology programs through industry or government employment.
Demonstrated track record leading mission-level operations analysis studies and delivering decision-quality results to senior engineering and customer stakeholders.
Extensive direct experience with combat simulations such as AFSIM, ESAMS, Brawler, Ansys STK, or equivalent, including ownership of rigorous methodology, not just execution.
Significant experience developing analytical tools and applying rigorous statistical methods to interpret and present results.
Strong proficiency in Python and MATLAB, including standard scientific computing libraries (such as Pandas, Polars, NumPy, SciPy, Scikit-Learn, Matplotlib, Seaborn, CuPy, or PyTorch).
Exceptional data visualization skills and comfort developing CONOPS/OV-1 visuals and briefing packages.
Proficiency with software development practices including version control and leveraging/validating outputs of AI-assisted coding tools.
Demonstrated ability to lead analytical efforts and deliver products with minimal oversight, including leading projects and studies.
Comfortable working on Linux-based systems and writing scalable scripts and software.
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including experience briefing flag/general officer or SES-level audiences.
Eligibility to obtain a Top Secret / Sensitive Compartmented Information (TS/SCI) clearance

Preferred Requirements

Active TS/SCI clearance.
Recognized expertise analyzing the full kill chain (find, fix, track, target, engage, assess) across multiple domains, including air-to-air, air-to-surface, surface-to-air, space, and electronic warfare engagements.
Deep expertise in sensor performance analysis (especially radar) and in developing and validating models of sensors, communications, weapons, aircraft, spacecraft, or ground/maritime systems in mission-level simulation environments such as AFSIM or Ansys STK.
Experience leading study teams or technical working groups across organizations, including model accreditation, V&V efforts, or threat-informed scenario development.
Experience designing and analyzing large-scale Monte Carlo and DOE-driven simulation campaigns supporting system effectiveness or kill chain assessment.
Exposure to Distributed Interactive Simulation (DIS) networking and visualization tools such as MAK VR-Forces, SIMDIS, or similar.
Experience supporting rapid development programs across DoD services, DARPA, ONR, AFRL, COCOMs, the acquisition community, or commercial advanced technology programs.
Experience supporting capture and positioning activities (RFI/RFP responses, white papers, technical exchanges) and shaping new business pursuits.

Why CHAOS?

Health Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision benefits 100% paid for by the company
Additional benefits: 401k (+ 50% company match up to 6% of pay), FSA, HSA, life insurance, and more
Our Perks: Free daily lunch, ‘No meeting Fridays’, unlimited PTO, casual dress code
Compensation Components: Competitive base salaries, generous pre-IPO stock option grants, relocation assistance, and (coming soon!) annual bonuses
Team Growth: 250 employees and counting across 5 global offices

jobs.description:
Your Job

We are seeking a Senior Business Analyst to serve as the bridge between business stakeholders, product leadership, and engineering teams across our platform portfolio, including a regulatory registry platform, a business identity verification platform, and a business messaging platform. In this role, you will translate complex business, customer, and regulatory requirements into actionable solutions that drive product development and operational excellence. You will partner with stakeholders, internally and externally, to ensure our platforms deliver value while meeting expectations.

Our Team

GCH Technologies was established to deliver innovative and transformative solutions to the telecommunications industry. Founded by industry veterans with extensive experience in messaging and wireless, GCH serves as a neutral party dedicated to advancing the wireless ecosystem.

What You Will Do

Own business requirements, functional specifications, process documentation, and user stories across our registry, identity verification, and business messaging platforms.
Translate customer, contractual, and regulatory requirements into clear, testable solutions for Engineering and QA teams.
Maintain traceability between business requirements, development work, and acceptance criteria.
Own requirements through delivery, ensuring work is clearly defined, implementation risks are addressed, and solutions meet business objectives.
Analyze, document, and maintain current and future-state business processes, workflows, business rules, and system interactions.
Identify process improvements, automation opportunities, and operational efficiencies that create value across the business.
Evaluate cross-product impacts and promote consistency across shared workflows, data models, and customer experiences.
Partner with Product Management on discovery, roadmap planning, prioritization, and solution definition.
Collaborate with Customer Success, Operations, customers, and external stakeholders to capture business needs and validate solutions.
Facilitate alignment across internal and external stakeholders through clear communication, documentation, process modeling, and solution validation.
Define reporting and analytics requirements supporting operational KPIs, SLAs, and customer reporting.
Analyze platform data and translate insights into actionable recommendations that support product, operational, and strategic decisions.

Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)

Experience gathering, documenting, and managing requirements through functional specifications, user stories, acceptance criteria, and related artifacts
Experience facilitating backlog refinement, stakeholder workshops, and cross-functional solution discussions
Experience supporting system integrations and API-driven solutions, including documenting data flows, business rules, and integration requirements.
Experience with process analysis, process mapping, and documentation skills using tools (Confluence, Lucidchart, Miro, or similar platforms)
Experience partnering with software engineering teams and external development vendors throughout the delivery lifecycle
Experience analyzing data using SQL or similar tools to support business decisions
Experience operating in a B2B or SaaS environment supporting customers and contractual service commitments
Experience building or supporting similar platforms in any industry, such as registries or compliance systems, identity or entity verification systems, or messaging/communications platforms

What Will Put You Ahead

Experience in telecommunications, messaging, or wireless ecosystems, including short codes, A2P messaging, rich business messaging, or carrier integrations
Experience leveraging KYC/KYB processes, identity verification platforms, or business entity data management
Experience with billing and subscription management platforms (Stripe, Chargebee, or similar)
Experience supporting regulated industries, industry associations, or compliance-driven business environments
Experience with business intelligence and data visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or QuickSight
Experience with website user experience (UX), including customer-facing web flows, usability, and design collaboration with UX/UI teams
CBAP, PMI-PBA, or similar business analysis certification
Spanish fluency

For this role, we anticipate paying $115k-$145k per year. This role is eligible for variable pay, issued as a monetary bonus or in another form.

Hiring Philosophy

All Koch companies value diversity of thought, perspectives, aptitudes, experiences, and backgrounds. We are Military Ready and Second Chance employers. Learn more about our hiring philosophy here.

Who We Are

At Koch, employees are empowered to do what they do best to make life better. Learn how our business philosophy helps employees unleash their potential while creating value for themselves and the company.

Our Benefits

Our goal is for each employee, and their families, to live fulfilling and healthy lives. We provide essential resources and support to build and maintain physical, financial, and emotional strength - focusing on overall wellbeing so you can focus on what matters most. Our benefits plan includes - medical, dental, vision, flexible spending and health savings accounts, life insurance, ADD, disability, retirement, paid vacation/time off, educational assistance, and may also include infertility assistance, paid parental leave and adoption assistance. Specific eligibility criteria is set by the applicable Summary Plan Description, policy or guideline and benefits may vary by geographic region. If you have questions on what benefits apply to you, please speak to your recruiter.

Additionally, everyone has individual work and personal needs. We seek to enable the best work environment that helps you and the business work together to produce superior results.

This role is part of the Enterprise Data organization and is primarily focused on the overarching governance and architecture of all data across the enterprise.

Description

Space Operation Staff Analyst

The successful candidate will support the Combined Forces Space Component Command (CFSCC) located at Vandenberg Space Force Base, CA (VSFB). You will have an exciting and important role joining a small team of experts providing operational-level advice to Command Leaders, supporting the development of military space operations plans and policies. This team helps to ensure unity-of-effort in space operations support to theater warfighters, US government and civil agencies, and commercial and foreign partners. In support of this Space Command warfighting organization, you will routinely interface with HQ United States Space Command (USSPACECOM), other USSPACECOM Components, Combatant Commands, assigned and attached subordinate units, Civil and Department of Defense (DoD) agencies, Coalition Partners, and others as necessary to facilitate the execution of missions and tasks. You will conduct international and domestic trips to coordinate planning efforts to strengthen collaboration and ensure alignment across all nations participating in Multi-National Forces – Operation OLYMPIC DEFENDER (MNF-OOD).

Technical support includes, but is not limited to, the following areas S4S S35, Future Operations and S4S S38, Integration Space Situational Awareness (SSA) sharing information, Space Domain Awareness (SDA), technical studies, and analyses; operations concept development; operations planning and support; evaluation of operations procedures, capabilities, and requirements; validation and verification activities; and program administrative, security, documentation, and presentation support. You will attend appropriate planning and development forums and technical interchange meetings to further understand the background and basis for developing technical analyses.

Travel is anticipated – approximately five one-week trips per year which may include international travel.

Plan, analyze, and assess Command and Control, SDA, SSA sharing and space control concepts, architectures, plans, policies, doctrine, and requirements.
Provide analytical and administrative support to, and/or products and documents for, combined/joint space operations planning consistent with Joint Publication 5.0, Joint Planning.
Analyze technical capabilities, mission objectives, and available resources to develop strategies, policy, and guidance, Concepts of Operations (CONOPS), alternatives and recommended solutions to achieve and/or optimize specific desired space operations goals and objectives to ensure CFSCC operations are positioned to support and anticipate end user needs (i.e. doctrine, organization, training, materiel, leadership and education, personnel and facilities).
Review, analyze, coordinate, recommend revisions to, and draft coordination of, space operations documents including Directives, Instructions, CONOPS, Agreements, Requirements, and other documents as required and provide knowledge management support for CFSCC operations and staff data, etc.
Provide analysis of potential impacts to the CFSCC missions and corresponding operations centers operations including global sensor issues, space events, and US and foreign space policy impacts.
Support resolution of anomalous events and USG or international policy changes that impact space operations.
Provide administrative and analytical support for the conduct of Commander Priorities, Readiness, Operations and other Assessments including analyzing and recommending revisions to ensure alignment with applicable orders/missions.
Provide analytical and administrative support at technical meetings to accomplish task requirements including working groups such as Lessons Learned and Rules of Engagement.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

Active Top Secret clearance at time of application with SCI eligibility.
Bachelor's degree with 5-10 years of relevant experience.
Experience providing decision support among diverse agencies, customers, and stakeholders (e.g., commercial, civil, governmental partners).
Demonstrated proficiency in conveying operational capabilities, limitations, employment needs and requirements through customer-desired products and forums.
Familiarity with space operations in context of joint operations.
Knowledge of varying types of military doctrine to include orders, plans, policies, instructions, and concepts of operations.
Ability to research various sources of information and compile concisely into presentations, information papers, briefings, etc.
Ability to obtain a U.S. Passport.

Desired Qualifications

Prior military experience.
Experience with military operations, planning, and policies.
Experience in space operations, joint operations and working with operational centers and international partners.
Knowledge of Joint Publication 3-14 Space Operations; Joint Publication 5-0, Joint Planning.
Knowledge of the Space Surveillance Network, Space Domain Awareness, SATCOM, Missile Warning/Defense, Global Sensor Management, Electromagnetic Interference, and Space Control.
