At Capital One, data is at the center of everything we do. When we launched as a startup we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

As a Data Analyst at Capital One you will leverage analytic and technical skills to innovate, build, and maintain well-managed data solutions and capabilities to tackle business problems.

On any given day you will be challenged on three types of work – Innovation, Business Intelligence and Data Management:

Innovation

Use Open Source/Digital technologies to mine complex, voluminous, and different varieties of data sources and platforms
Build well-managed data solutions, tools, and capabilities to enable self-service frameworks for data consumers
Demonstrate ability to explore and quickly grasp new technologies to progress varied initiatives

Business Intelligence

Partner with the business to provide consultancy and translate the business needs to design and develop tools, techniques, metrics, and dashboards for insights and data visualization
Drive analysis that provides meaningful insights on business strategies

Data Management

Drive an understanding and adherence to the principles of data quality management including metadata, lineage, and business definitions
Work collaboratively with appropriate Tech teams to manage security mechanisms and data access governance
Build and execute tools to monitor and report on data quality

Our ideal candidate will have:

Degree specialized in a Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics discipline
Scripting experience in (Python, R, Spark, and SQL)
Strong desire and experience with data in various forms (data warehouses/SQL, unstructured data)
Experience utilizing and developing within AWS services

Basic Qualifications

Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Bachelor’s Degree in quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science or a related quantitative field) plus at least 5 years of experience performing data analytics, or currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Master’s Degree plus at least 3 years performing data analytics with an expectation that required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date.
At least 3 years of experience working with at least one scripting language
At least 3 years of experience utilizing a business intelligence visualization tool
At least 3 years of experience in querying, analyzing and working with data languages and platforms

Preferred Qualifications:

Master’s Degree in a Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics discipline
At least 4 years of experience coding in Python, R, Spark, or SQL
At least 4 years of experience working within process management and improvement methodologies – Agile, Lean, Six Sigma, etc.
At least 2 years of experience utilizing and developing within AWS services
At least 2 years of experience delivering Data Governance and Data Quality Management concepts and practices within the financial services industry

jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Shine is the financial copilot for entrepreneurs and small business owners.

Founded by serial entrepreneurs Rico Andersen and Martin Hegelund, Shine is a leading European fintech unicorn on a mission to restore the joy of running a business, by ending wasted time on financial admin. Shine offers a connected solution for invoicing, accounting, payroll, business accounts, payments, and financing, meaning business owners can focus their energy on growing a healthy business, not held back by manual admin.

Part of something bigger

Today we're part of Cegid, a European leader in cloud software for finance and accounting. Together we're building Europe's leading financial copilot for small businesses and their accountants.

Shine already supports more than 400,000 small businesses. As part of Cegid, we now reach over one million small businesses and 15,000 accountants across Europe.

We're a multicultural team working from France, Germany, Denmark and the Netherlands, contributing to a wider European network that spans Spain, Portugal and Belgium.

Your Hiring Experience Matters

Just as we respect our customers' time, we respect yours. Your experience with Shine and Cegid should feel simple, transparent and genuinely supportive.

If this sounds like somewhere you want to grow, we'd love to hear from you.

The CPA Tribe Analytics team at Shine

We support the CPA products with data analytics. Our partners are the Product org and the country Business Units. We are three analysts and we are growing. This is a new position.

Your role as a Senior Data Analyst

You report to the Head of Data Analytics. Your main stakeholder is the French Business Unit, a sales-heavy B2B organisation.

Two Things Make This Role Challenging

Our data lives in different systems: CRM, data warehouse, product data. Bringing it together is part of the job.
The French BU is a B2B business inside an overall B2C-minded company. You will work between both worlds.

Your Responsibilities Will Include

Creating one consistent view across CRM, data warehouse and product data.
Building lead scoring, pipeline analytics and other sales analytics solutions that the French BU uses weekly.
You take ownership of the analytics for the French BU leadership and bring them decision-ready insight.
Supporting the Product org and the country Business Units with analytics for the CPA/Advisor products.

📍Job located in France, Paris with possibility of two remote working days per week

About You

You have 5+ yrs hands-on analytics experience, including in a B2B setting. SaaS and/or CPA background is a strong preference.
You have done advanced analytics in a sales organisation, for example lead scoring or pipeline analytics.
You have brought data from different systems together (CRM, data warehouse, product data) and got teams to agree on it.
You have driven data-driven decision making, working directly with senior leadership.
You work with SQL, dbt, Omni and Python. Salesforce or a similar CRM is familiar to you.
You are fluent in French and English (C1).

Equal Opportunity Employer

We follow the principle of equal treatment to consider all job applicants and do not discriminate based on their gender, sexual orientation, color, racial or ethnic origin, religion, disability, etc. as per applicable law.

Our recruitment process

1️⃣ Screening Call:
Initial screening call with a TA-partner

2️⃣ Technical Call (60’): Discussion with Julian (Analytics Manager)

3️⃣ Case Study Presentation including a technical SQL challenge (75’): Evaluation of your methodology, problem-structuring, and impact mindset.

4️⃣ Meet the team (30') to get an better idea of the environment.

jobs.description:
Welcome to Whataburger Careers!

Our Flavor — Why Whataburger

Whataburger isn’t just a fast-food burger chain it is where bold leadership starts — and where potential doesn’t just grow, it heats up. Whether you're leading the line or working behind the scenes, this is the place where opportunities stack up, and every day gives you a chance to Make a Difference.

Since 1950, we’ve invested in people who lead with integrity, Serve with Heart , and bring their best flavor to the team. We believe in working together, speaking up, having a little fun, and Winning as One — because great burgers (and great teams) start with the right ingredients. If you're ready — to learn, grow, impact, and Move Forward Boldly — we’ve got your back and your path cooked to perfection.

Your Recipe For Impact — What You’ll Do

As an Accounting Data Analyst, you'll transform financial and operational data into insights that help leaders make better business decisions. Supporting Whataburger's growing third-party delivery and franchise businesses, you'll use SQL, analytics, and reporting tools to identify trends, investigate issues, improve processes, and drive financial performance. Your understanding of accounting principles and financial processes will help ensure data accuracy, support period-end close activities, and translate complex business activity into meaningful financial insights that leaders can trust.

Day-to-Day Ingredients — Responsibilities

As an Accounting Data Analyst, you will:

Develop SQL queries to analyze financial and operational data
Identify trends, risks, and opportunities through data analysis
Conduct ad hoc analysis to diagnose issues and support resolution
Prepare financial analysis and materials for leadership review
Support accounting processes, including reconciliations and journal entries
Partner with cross-functional teams to support business initiatives
Support timely and accurate period- and year-end close processes
Maintain accurate, consistent financial data and reporting
Improve reporting efficiency and data quality

The Sauce — Pay & Perks

As An Accounting Data Analyst, You Will Receive

Competitive Weekly Pay
Bonus Program that scales up to 2.5X payout potential based on company results
5 weeks PTO
Flex Weeks
Paid Corporate Holidays
Paid Parental Leave*
401(k) match $1/$1 up to 4%
Competitive Medical, Dental and Vision Benefits*
Short-term and Long-term Disability Benefits*
Opportunities for Career Development and Growth
Whataburger Family Foundation - Scholarship Program (dependents eligible) and Hardship Grant Assistance
Discounted Meals for You and a Guest
Wireless Service Discounts
Computer & Software Discounts
Fitness / Gym Discounts
Awards and recognition for all you do
Retirement Celebration Program

What You Bring To The Table — Required Experience

As an Accounting Data Analyst, you must have:

Bachelor’s degree in Business Analytics, Accounting, Finance, or a related field
2+ years of financial analysis, accounting or related experience
Advanced Excel skills, including XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, Pivot tables, and data validation
Intermediate experience developing SQL queries to extract, join, and analyze data, including aggregate functions and subqueries
Ability to research and analyze discrepancies by querying underlying transactional data
Experience with variance, trend, and performance analysis
Proficiency in financial reporting and data tools
Understanding of journal entries and account reconciliations
Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
Clear written and verbal communication abilities

Extra Toppings — Desired Experience

As an Accounting Data Analyst, we prefer you to have:

Experience supporting third-party delivery or multi-unit operations
Experience using analytics and reporting tools such as Snowflake, Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms
Exposure to reporting or process automation
Experience partnering cross‑functionally outside of Finance
Familiarity with continuous process improvement initiatives

Where & How You’ll Work

This role is based at the San Antonio Home Office, working on‑site Monday through Thursday with remote flexibility on Fridays. In this role, you’ll have strong collaboration with leadership, across cross-functional teams, and with external partners to align capabilities with restaurant realities. The work environment is fast‑paced and requires sound judgment, strategic thinking, and strong collaboration skills. Full‑time availability is required, with occasional extended hours based on business needs, along with occasional travel to properties, project sites, and external meetings. jobs.title: Project Manager, Airside
jobs.description:
TYLin
is a globally recognized, full-service infrastructure consulting firm committed to providing innovative, cost-effective, constructible designs for the global infrastructure market. With over 3,000 employees throughout the Americas, Asia, and Europe, the firm provides support on projects of varying size and complexity. Together, we enhance conventional designs with smarter, more resilient systems. We provide people with better mobility. We steward precious resources by finding more sustainable solutions.

Job Summary

TYLin is seeking an experienced Project Manager, Airside to provide design leadership on some of the largest and most complex airport redevelopment programs in North America. This is a unique opportunity for an accomplished aviation professional to lead multidisciplinary design teams, manage key stakeholder relationships, and help deliver world-class airside facilities to shape the long-term development of aviation infrastructure.

We are looking for an exceptional design leader with extensive experience managing the design of major airside projects in the United States or internationally. The successful candidate will bring a proven ability to lead complex multidisciplinary teams while collaborating closely with airport owners, general contractors, design consultants, airlines, and other project stakeholders throughout the lifecycle of large capital programs.

Responsibilities & Qualifications

The Opportunity

TYLin is seeking an experienced Project Manager – Airside to lead the planning, design, and delivery of complex airfield/airside projects for major aviation programs. This is an exciting opportunity to join a globally recognized aviation practice and contribute to the transformation of some of the world’s most important airport facilities.

We are looking for a project manager with a strong background in airside/airfield design and redevelopment, who has successfully led multidisciplinary design teams on major projects in the United States or internationally. The successful candidate will have experience coordinating architects, engineers, planners, specialty consultants, airport stakeholders, airlines, and operational teams to deliver innovative, functional, and passenger-focused terminal environments.

Responsibilities

Lead the design delivery of major airfield projects for commercial, regional, and general aviation airports.
Manage multidisciplinary design teams including architects, engineers, planners, aviation specialists, and specialty consultants.
Coordinate all phases of airside design, including programming, concept design, schematic design, design development, construction documentation, and construction administration.
Develop and manage project scope, schedule, budget, staffing plans, and delivery strategies.
Facilitate design coordination meetings and ensure alignment between architectural, engineering, operational, and stakeholder requirements.
Review and manage design deliverables, technical submissions, and quality assurance processes.
Coordinate with construction teams to support constructability reviews, phasing strategies, and implementation planning.
Identify project risks and develop mitigation strategies to maintain design quality, schedule, and budget objectives.

Qualifications

Required

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Airfield Planning, Architecture, Engineering, or a related discipline.
10+ years of progressive experience delivering complex airside/airfield design projects.
Experience leading multidisciplinary design teams on complex aviation projects.
Strong understanding of airfield planning, architectural design, operational requirements, and airfield layouts.
Proven ability to manage project scope, schedule, budget, quality, and client expectations.
Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
Experience coordinating with airport authorities, airlines, tenants, contractors, and regulatory agencies.

Preferred

Registered Architect (RA) or Professional Engineer (PE) license.
Experience delivering projects for the Port Authority of New York & New Jersey (PANYNJ).
Experience on large hub airport redevelopment programs valued in the hundreds of millions or billions of dollars.
Experience with Design-Build, Progressive Design-Build, CMAR, or Public-Private Partnership (P3) delivery models.
PMP certification is considered an asset.

Typical Project Experience

The ideal candidate will have led the design and coordination of projects such as:

Airfield layouts
Aircraft parking layout design
Airport Master Plans
Facility requirement analyses
Capacity and operational studies
Phasing and development plans

Ideal Candidate

You are a collaborative design leader with a passion for aviation infrastructure and a reputation for delivering technically complex airport projects. You excel at bringing together diverse teams, resolving competing priorities, and fostering strong partnerships between clients, contractors, and consultants.

You understand that successful airport projects require more than technical expertise—they demand proactive communication, strategic thinking, and the ability to align multiple stakeholders around a shared vision. Your experience leading large-scale terminal programs has equipped you to confidently navigate the challenges of delivering projects in operational airports while maintaining the highest standards of design quality, safety, and project performance.

Why TYLin?

TYLin is a global leader in aviation planning, architecture, engineering, and program management. We partner with airport owners to deliver innovative, sustainable, and resilient infrastructure that enhances passenger experience and supports long-term operational success.

Joining our Aviation practice means you'll have the opportunity to:

Lead the design of landmark airport projects.
Collaborate with internationally recognized aviation experts across multiple disciplines.
Influence the delivery of some of North America's most significant airport capital programs.
Grow your career within a collaborative, employee-focused organization committed to technical excellence and innovation.
Receive a competitive compensation package and comprehensive benefits.

Join Us

If you are an experienced aviation design leader with a proven track record of delivering major airport terminal projects and building trusted relationships with clients, contractors, and consultant teams, we invite you to join TYLin.

Help shape the next generation of airport terminals by leading designs that are innovative, operationally efficient, and centered on the passenger experience.

Additional Information

TYLin is committed to pay equity. As part of that commitment, we have provided the base compensation range of $153,600 - $210,600 annually for this position and local market. We recognize that each candidate brings a unique set of skills, experience, education and competencies to the table that will be reflected in our offer. TYLin is proud to offer exciting career development opportunities.

TYLin
offers a comprehensive total rewards package. Our benefits may include extensive medical, disability and life insurance coverage, continuing education benefits, paid time off, employee assistance program and a retirement savings plan with company matching contributions.

We encourage all candidates to explore our total rewards offering.

Collaboration, mission-driven focus, discipline, and leadership skills developed through military service benefit us all. Whether you are a Veteran, Guardsman or Reservist, a Military Spouse or you are planning to transition to civilian life in the near future, we welcome and value your application.

TYLin
is an equal opportunity employer, and we prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type as protected by federal, provincial, state or local laws. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. The company and its employees are required to comply with all local health authority, legal or lawful client requirements.

Instacart is on a mission to make eating well effortless for everyone and great design is a key ingredient. This role sits at the intersection of design craft, technical operations, and strategic execution. You'll bring strong design sensibility—whether from product design or design systems—to build scalable programs, automate workflows using AI, and ensure our design team has the infrastructure, tools, and processes to deliver world-class experiences efficiently. You'll own end-to-end program execution for high-visibility design initiatives while building the operational backbone that enables the Design organization to scale. Systems & Tooling: Champion team health through capacity planning, roadmapping, and resource allocation. Build operational metrics and tooling integrations that create seamless workflows across platforms.
Design Systems & Cross-Functional Partnership: Partner with the Instacart Design System (IDS) team to align programs with system evolution and component adoption. Drive governance programs that scale IDS across product teams. Act as strategic partner to Product, Engineering, Marketing, Legal, and Operations. Translate design strategy into executable programs with clear visibility into progress and outcomes. Facilitate planning cycles and milestone reviews where design intersects with product roadmaps.
Design Craft Integration: Apply design thinking and product sense to program design—understanding user needs, designing operational experiences, and iterating based on feedback. Build systems that empower designers and product managers to do their best work while balancing flexibility with consistency, creative exploration with scalable patterns, and craft excellence with business impact.

About You

6+ years in program management and design operations within design or product organizations, with deep experience driving operational excellence and culture for design and product teams.
Strong product sense and design craft sensibility, with well-developed methods and tools for driving fluid programs forward into the market.
Experience with all stages of the product development lifecycle, launching products end-to-end.
(component libraries, tokens, documentation, cross-platform patterns)

AI fluency: Experience leveraging AI tools (LLMs, automation platforms) to drive efficiency and scale programs
Vendor/contract management experience: negotiating software contracts, managing relationships, optimizing spend, ensuring compliance

Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; comfortable presenting to executive leadership

NVIDIA is seeking someone with a strong background in silicon bring-up and productization, with a focus on testability. Drive pre-silicon test readiness, ensuring DFX features, test patterns and ATE test programs are ready ahead of tapeout and silicon arrival
Lead post-silicon DFX bring-up execution, coordinating SCAN, MBIST, IO and other test content debug across DFX, validation and test engineering teams
Track and drive productization milestones partnering with Operations, including ATE test time reduction, test coverage, yield learning and DPPM/quality targets required for qualification and production release
Coordinate handoffs to Operations and support production ramp readiness, including system-level and datacenter test needs
Run regular program execution reviews, capture decisions, actions and owners, manage scope changes, and drive items to closure

Assemble lessons learned and apply standard methodologies from one program to another to continuously improve DFX execution

What We Need To See

BS (Masters preferred) in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or a related field or equivalent experience
6+ years of experience in semiconductor technical program management, test engineering, DFX or post-silicon validation
Hands-on knowledge of the ASIC/SoC development flow, with working familiarity with DFX concepts (SCAN, ATPG, MBIST, JTAG) and post-silicon bring-up, test and productization
Demonstrated ability to drive execution with multi-functional teams and concurrent programs while keeping sophisticated schedules on track

Self-motivated and proactive with strong attention to detail and demonstrated critical thinking capabilities

new_jobs.description:
Position Overview

As a Project Manager, you'll lead and manage commercial HVAC projects from preconstruction through closeout, coordinating field teams, subcontractors, vendors, and clients to deliver on-time, on-budget results with exceptional safety, quality, and customer satisfaction. Working closely with operations leadership, you'll proactively identify risks/opportunities, track budgets, foster open communication, and drive profitability while building long-term relationships. Our people-first culture empowers your leadership with professional development, mentorship, cross-functional collaboration, and the opportunity to mentor teams in delivering sustainable, efficient mechanical systems nationwide at any of our operating companies.

Duties And Responsibilities

Manage full project lifecycle: planning, scheduling, budgeting, resource allocation, risk management, change orders, and closeout for HVAC/mechanical projects.
Review bid documents, drawings, and scopes early to identify potential issues, opportunities, risks, omissions, and value engineering possibilities; develop workable solutions to prevent problems.
Collaborate with preconstruction, estimating, and operations teams to create realistic schedules, budgets, and project plans that meet milestones and financial targets.
Track project budgets, costs, labor productivity, variances, and forecasts; identify shortcomings/pitfalls or profit-enhancing opportunities and implement corrective actions.
Promote open communication among project teams, clients, architects, engineers, subcontractors, and internal departments to resolve conflicts and ensure alignment.
Organize and lead coordination meetings, site walks, and progress reviews; maintain detailed documentation of scope changes, execution decisions, costs, and client communications.
Ensure strict adherence to contract documents, specifications, company policies, safety requirements, quality expectations, and ethical standards.
Champion quality assurance: conduct job-site reviews, ensure installations meet/exceed industry standards, prevent call-backs/warranty issues, and partner with quality teams on processes/inspections.
Build and maintain long-term relationships with clients, architects, engineers, general contractors, subcontractors, and vendors to support repeat business and future opportunities.
Recruit, train, mentor, and develop project team members; track performance, delegate appropriately, nominate for promotions/incentives, and participate in hiring as needed.
Enforce safety compliance across teams: assure PPE usage, coordinate with safety officers for inspections/visits, and uphold company/project safety protocols at all times.
Provide leadership vision for project planning, coordination, sequencing, labor utilization, and continuous improvement; communicate updates and issues to executive leadership.

Supervisory Responsibilities

Yes – Direct supervision and leadership of superintendents, foremen, field personnel, and support staff on assigned projects; responsible for performance evaluations, training/mentoring, promotions/incentives, conflict resolution, and team development to ensure high performance, safety adherence, and project success.

Requirements/Qualifications

Experience: 5–10+ years of progressive project management experience in commercial HVAC/mechanical construction or related building services; proven track record managing teams and projects valued from $500K to multi-million dollars.
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Mechanical Engineering, or related field preferred; equivalent experience with strong technical HVAC knowledge considered.
Certifications: PMP, LEED, OSHA 30-hour, or relevant trade certifications a plus; valid driver's license and clean driving record required.
Physical Demands: Primarily office-based with frequent job-site visits; ability to walk active construction sites, climb ladders/stairs, lift light materials (plans, laptop), and travel regionally/nationally as needed; standard office mobility for computer work and meetings.
Work Environment/Safety: Professional office with hybrid options and active construction sites; exposure to varying weather, noise, dust, heights; must adhere to OSHA regulations, conduct hazard identification, and wear required PPE (hard hat, safety glasses, steel-toed boots) on sites—safety is our top priority and non-negotiable. This is a safety-sensitive position.

Required Skills

Advanced project management (scheduling, budgeting, risk management, change order negotiation, cost control).
Strong leadership, team mentoring, performance management, and conflict resolution.
Proficiency with project tools (Procore, MS Project, Bluebeam, Excel) and financial tracking.
Excellent written/verbal communication, client/stakeholder management, and relationship building.
Safety and quality leadership; ability to read/interpret contracts, blueprints, specs, and scopes.
Multitasking under pressure, initiative, professionalism, and commitment to ethics/compliance.

Modigent Overview

Modigent is a national leader delivering next-generation infrastructure, technology, and energy solutions through our family of specialized brands in HVAC, plumbing, and controls systems. With a strong coast-to-coast presence and extensive service capabilities, we empower customers, communities, and our over 1,500 team members to thrive with sustainable, efficient commercial building services. As part of our team, you'll contribute to thoughtful innovation and our people-first culture rooted in service, collaboration, and integrity.

Why Work at Modigent

Competitive compensation based on experience and level, with opportunities for performance incentives and tool allowances where applicable.
Comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus HSA options with employer contributions in select plans, and company-paid basic life and accidental death & dismemberment insurance.
Paid time off, holiday pay, and a 401(k) retirement savings plan to support your long-term financial well-being.
Professional development through hands-on training, mentorship, apprenticeships, certifications, and clear career advancement paths across our nationwide operating companies.
Inclusive, supportive culture that values diversity, dignity, respect, collaboration, integrity, and personal fulfillment—empowering you to build a rewarding, long-term career.

new_jobs.description:
About Qontour

Qontour is a design and development studio that builds strategic, high-performing websites for B2B technology companies. We partner with growth-stage clients to create brand-forward web experiences that convert – blending clean design, sharp positioning, and smart systems. We are a Premium Webflow Enterprise Partner and have built our agency around low-code development.

The Role

We’re looking for a project manager to run delivery on three concurrent client website projects over the next 2–3 months. This is hands-on delivery management: you’ll own the projects, keep work moving, and make sure nothing stalls waiting on a decision (or an asset). This is a contract engagement with an immediate start. There is no ramp-up period, so we need someone with proven experience successfully shipping Webflow projects.

What You’ll Do

Manage multiple active Webflow builds: timelines, deliverables, team coordination
Manage project tracking in ClickUp (agency-side) and Asana (client-side) – status, priorities, and comments
Coordinate with clients to obtain content, assets, and approvals before they become blockers
Support the internal team with their day-to-day needs, removing blockers as they come up
Flag slippage early and propose the fix, not just the problem
Partner with client managers to communicate with clients, primarily async
Coordinate handoffs between design, development, and QA

What You Bring

2+ years building or managing Webflow site development, with recent, proven experience shipping successful projects – you know frameworks and CMS collections, bring designer-level knowledge, and can communicate with developers on their terms
3+ years managing website projects, including 2+ years at a digital agency working directly with clients, ideally B2B technology
Strong technical understanding of how websites are structured and webpages are built – HTML/CSS/JavaScript and performance considerations
Working proficiency in ClickUp and Asana – views, task structure, dependencies, Gantt views, status reporting
Clear, confident written communication and strong documentation habits
A bias toward initiative – you anticipate needs and get things moving rather than waiting
Comfort working in a fully remote, async-first, globally distributed team

Bonus Points For

Experience on Webflow Enterprise accounts, using the full suite of Webflow features (Localization, Analyze, Optimize)
Familiarity with QA, analytics, and performance monitoring tools
Working knowledge of SEO/AEO/GEO fundamentals

Details

Part-time, up to 32 hours per week
2–3 month contract
$50–70 USD/hour, depending on experience
Fully remote – United States or Canada
Flexible hours within an async-first team culture
No benefits

To Apply

Tell us about your hands-on Webflow experience, including specific projects you managed to launch, and one web project that went wrong and what you did about it. You’ll be asked to discuss Webflow mechanics in real time and to walk us through a project plan you have actually used for a website build.

Power the customer experiences that run on Azure. Our team sits at the intersection of customer experience, Azure capacity, and operational excellence, ensuring that critical customer workloads and first-party services have the capacity, reliability, and supportability they need to succeed. You will work across engineering, capacity planning, support, field, and leadership teams to drive strategic improvements that strengthen customer outcomes and the Azure platform.

You will build scalable systems, processes, and agent-assisted workflows that proactively identify risks, influence engineering priorities, and improve customer outcomes at cloud scale. This opportunity will allow you to deepen your expertise in cloud infrastructure, drive cross-organizational strategy, and lead transformative initiatives that shape the future of Azure customer experience.

As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Own the Azure Data and Database customer experience portfolio by translating customer, operational, telemetry, and capacity signals into strategic actions that improve capacity availability, reliability, and customer outcomes.
Define and evolve portfolio-level strategy, operating models, and governance for how Azure capacity customer experience is managed across customers, services, regions, and partner organizations.
Build scalable mechanisms for demand signal management, prioritization, escalation management, capacity decision-making, proactive risk mitigation, and stakeholder communications.
Lead the transformation of manual customer experience processes into system-led and agent-assisted workflows that improve efficiency, consistency, and decision quality at scale.
Partner across engineering, product management, capacity planning, field, support, operations, and business teams to align priorities, influence investments, and deliver customer-focused outcomes.
Identify emerging risks, gaps, and opportunities, and lead the development of durable solutions that address root causes and improve long-term customer and business results.

Responsibilities

Lead Taiwan-based early-stage design and engineering programs with ODM/CM and Microsoft engineering partners, translating program priorities into aligned outcomes and effective local execution.
Align Taiwan lab support, readiness, and resource priorities with engineering demand. Influence capacity and capability decisions to improve program efficiency while balancing competing needs.

Connect Taiwan, US, and global labs through two-way sharing of engineering expertise, best practices, resources, and capabilities. Promote reuse and reduce time-zone and remote-management friction.
Lead cross-organizational resolution of program risks, dependencies, and decisions in partnership with existing engineering and operational owners. Clarify tradeoffs and drive issues to closure without duplicating technical ownership.
Use program evidence and partner feedback to identify improvements in local engineering execution and lab collaboration. Scale practices that strengthen readiness, quality, resource effectiveness, and business outcomes.
Communicate program health, priorities, risks, and recommendations to stakeholders. Build alignment on decisions and resource tradeoffs across Taiwan partners and global engineering leadership.
Shape Taiwan lab and engineering partner collaboration strategy with engineering, sourcing, and operations leaders. Align partner capabilities with evolving program needs while respecting established commercial and operational ownership.

Bachelor's Degree AND 6+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development OR equivalent experience.
5+ years of experience leading cross-functional programs across engineering, operations, hardware, infrastructure, manufacturing, lab, or supply chain environments.
Experience establishing operating mechanisms that align program priorities, ownership, dependencies, and delivery commitments across teams.
Experience influencing senior stakeholders and driving alignment across teams without direct authority.

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree AND 12+ years experience engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development OR equivalent experience.
Experience with hardware development lifecycles, engineering labs, manufacturing, or engineering collaboration with ODM/CM partners.
Experience in product hardware design or validation, including working with engineering teams to define requirements, execute verification plans, analyze test results, and drive issue resolution through development milestones.
Experience leading programs across multinational, matrixed engineering and partner organizations, including collaboration across Taiwan, US, or other global teams.
Strong analytical skills and experience using data to assess program health, inform resource tradeoffs, and improve quality and delivery predictability.

The NAMER Cloud Sales Center (CSC) is AGS's primary scale revenue engine and its most important talent developer, delivering $4B in revenue and ambitious annual growth. Early career talent sits at the heart of that engine: these sellers feed up to 60% of Field sellers and contribute an outsized share of CSC pipeline. This role owns the front door to that system.

As Senior Program Manager for Early Career Talent & Employer Brand, you own how CSC attracts, selects, and launches the next generation of sellers, and how the market sees CSC as the place to start a career in cloud sales. You will own the internship program, the co-op program, and the broader early-career strategy that shapes the caliber, diversity, engagement, and readiness of everyone who enters AGS through this door. This is a role that is strategic and tactical in equal measure: you will set multi-year strategy while running live cohorts that deliver measurable, in-year business impact.

You will join a team of senior program leaders in the CSC Strategic Initiatives Team, each owning a connected part of the talent flywheel — enablement, talent strategy and matriculation, platforms and data, and partner activation. You own the top of that flywheel and the employer brand that fills it. Success looks like a high-caliber, diverse, engaged early-career pipeline that converts faster, ramps faster, and strengthens CSC's competitive position for the next generation of GenAI-native sellers.

Key job responsibilities

Own the early-career talent portfolio end to end: Connect the internship program, co-op program, and strategy into a single entry-point to the CSC’s integrated talent engine
Own CSC's early-career employer brand and talent profile: Define who we attract and how we are seen, while treating the caliber, diversity, and engagement of incoming talent as a strategic lever
Set strategy and run execution: Design the multi-year early-career model while owning live cohorts and their in-year pipeline and conversion outcomes
Feed the talent flywheel: Partner with leadership on matriculation timing and workforce-planning inputs so early-career talent flows predictably into onboarding, development, and Field roles
Set and hold the intake quality bar: Ensure new talent is prepared for full-time roles, accelerating time to productivity and increasing impact
Prove impact with data: Collaborate with data teams to instrument early-career conversion, ramp, and diversity metrics to clearly articulate ROI
Amplify through partners: Connect employer-brand moments and early-career events into the broader partner activation strategy so they reinforce the wider engine
Operate with executive visibility: Represent early-career talent as a named pillar of the org's talent strategy, with regular exposure to senior leadership and Field partners

You start the morning reviewing conversion and pipeline data from the current cohort with the data team, then join a working session with talent-strategy leadership on matriculation timing for the next intake. In the afternoon you sync with enablement on the intake quality bar, align an upcoming early-career event with the partner team, and close the day preparing a readout for senior leadership on the two things that matter most this quarter.

Our team is focused on delivering programs that have broad impact across Amazon. We work collaboratively with leaders across AWS to solve problems at scale. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

AWS Support also partners with a global list of customers that are building mission-critical applications on top of AWS services.

Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements

Description

CPH is a multi-disciplinary Engineering and Architecture firm that ranks in the nation’s Top 500 Design Firms by ENR Magazine. We are seeking a Senior Program Manager to join and help lead our dynamic team in Sanford, FL
!

The Senior Program Manager is responsible for leading strategic commercial development programs from business development through successful project delivery and client relationship growth. This role combines program leadership, business development, financial accountability, and team development to build profitable, sustainable client programs across Retail, Mixed-Use, Industrial, and other private development markets.

Working closely with executive leadership, the Senior Program Manager will strengthen key client relationships, identify new business opportunities, expand multidisciplinary services, and lead high-performing teams in delivering complex commercial site/civil development programs throughout Florida and the Southeast.

Duties Include

Client Development & Business Growth
Represent CPH professionally, developing and strengthening long-term relationships with strategic commercial clients, developers, owners, consultants, and industry partners.
Identify opportunities to expand CPH's Architecture, Structural Engineering, MEP, Civil Engineering, Surveying, and other multidisciplinary services.
Lead business development activities and support strategic market expansion throughout Florida and the Southeast.
Identify, pursue, and convert new opportunities aligned with CPH's strategic growth objectives.
Prepare proposals, scopes of work, project strategies, schedules, staffing plans, and fee estimates.
Participate in client presentations, interviews, negotiations, and professional services agreement development.
Partner with executive leadership to develop and execute strategic account and market growth plans.

Program & Project Leadership
Lead multidisciplinary teams delivering complex commercial building development programs.
Provide overall leadership and accountability for project planning, execution, and client communication.
Maintain accountability for program scope, schedule, budget, staffing, quality, risk, and client satisfaction.
Coordinate resources across Architecture, Structural Engineering, MEP, Civil Engineering, Surveying, and other disciplines to ensure efficient and profitable project delivery.
Establish program priorities, delivery strategies, milestones, and performance expectations.
Proactively identify and address project risks, scope changes, resource constraints, and client concerns.
Ensure projects are delivered in accordance with CPH standards, contractual requirements, and client expectations.
Promote consistent project management practices and operational excellence across assigned programs.

Business Unit Leadership
Serve as a strategic partner to the Senior Vice President and Business Unit leadership team.
Support business planning, resource forecasting, staffing strategies, and long-term program development.
Identify opportunities to improve operational performance, delivery processes, and profitability.
Support the development and implementation of Business Unit growth strategies.
Contribute to market intelligence, competitive analysis, and identification of emerging opportunities.
Help establish repeatable processes and delivery models that support scalable program growth.
Promote accountability, collaboration, innovation, continuous improvement, client service, and profitable growth.

Team Leadership & Development
Lead, mentor, and develop project managers, engineers, technical professionals, and other team members.
Build high-performing multidisciplinary teams aligned with program requirements and client expectations.
Establish clear roles, responsibilities, performance expectations, and accountability.
Support succession planning and development of future program and project leaders.
Provide coaching and feedback to strengthen technical, project management, business development, and leadership capabilities.
Foster a collaborative environment across Civil, Surveying, Landscape Architecture, Architecture, and other disciplines.

Financial & Operational Accountability
Maintain accountability for program financial performance and profitability.
Develop and monitor project and program budgets, forecasts, staffing plans, and resource requirements.
Evaluate project performance and implement corrective actions when necessary.
Manage scope, change orders, contractual requirements, and fee utilization.
Support accurate revenue forecasting, backlog management, and invoicing.
Ensure project teams maintain appropriate documentation and follow established CPH financial and operational procedures.

Requirements

Education and Experience:

Required
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, Business, or a related discipline.
Minimum of 10 years of progressive experience in A/E consulting, engineering, construction, commercial development, or a related professional services environment.
Demonstrated experience leading complex commercial development programs and multidisciplinary teams.
Proven experience developing and managing strategic client relationships.
Demonstrated experience with proposals, scope development, fee development, budgeting, scheduling, staffing, and contract negotiations.
Demonstrated experience managing financial performance and profitability of projects or programs.
Experience leading and developing teams of technical professionals.

Preferred
Professional Engineering (PE) license, professional registration, technical certification, or equivalent industry experience.
PMP certification, MBA, or other advanced business or project management credential.
Experience supporting national or regional commercial clients.
Experience within Retail, Mixed-Use, Industrial, Healthcare, Education, Assisted Living, Facilities, or other private development markets.
Experience managing programs or teams of approximately 10 or more professionals.
Established network of commercial developers, owners, consultants, or industry partners.
Experience supporting market expansion across Florida or the Southeast.

Compensation & Benefits

Dependent upon experience.
CPH offers Medical, Dental and Vision and Long-Term Disability with a quality insurance company.
Company Paid Life Insurance and Short-Term Disability.
401K, Paid Personal Time Off, Paid Holidays, and Paid Paternal Leave.

The Utility Development Program Manager
will support the overall planning and execution of QTS utility infrastructure. This role will interface and collaborate with many critical stakeholders, including but not limited to energy leaders responsible for utility contracts and negotiations; utility engagement developing relationships with utilities and transmission providers; pre-development leads evaluating new properties; operations leaders managing load growth projections; and development team project leaders planning and building new data centers.

Management of partners and consultants related to electrical substation and transmission line design and construction
Lead in standardization of utility substation design, including distribution feeds to multiple buildings

Support transmission interconnection processes, including coordination with utilities, ISOs/RTOs, and regulatory bodies to secure timely energization
Manage budgets and cost forecasting of utility projects, including construction and equipment for both substation and transmission line scopes
Develop transformer, transmission structure, and equipment specifications
Procure substation long lead equipment, transmission line materials (conductor, structures, insulators), and transformers
Procure and manage the construction of multiple substation and transmission line sites simultaneously
Track and report on the status and schedule of power delivery timelines, including transmission line milestones and interconnection dependencies
Support natural gas utility development activities, including coordination with gas providers, pipeline routing, service agreements, permitting, easements, and schedule alignment with campus power delivery needs

Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, construction, or equivalent experience

Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including PowerPoint for executive reporting and Excel for budgets and tracking
Ability to travel up to 50%

10+ years of electrical substation, transmission line, or utility infrastructure construction experience
Strong industry knowledge of utility partners, transformer manufacturers, transmission contractors, and material suppliers
Technical expertise in high- and medium-voltage electrical design or construction, including overhead and underground transmission systems
Experience with transmission permitting, ROW acquisition, regulatory/ISO interconnection, and natural gas utility coordination
Experience managing large portfolios of utility or infrastructure work

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

Strong verbal and written communication skills
Ability to be flexible and adapt to changing situations at a high growth company
Ability to build strong internal and external working relationships with utilities, transmission providers, and regulatory agencies
Ability to coordinate across electric and gas utilities to align infrastructure delivery, permitting, easement, and service requirements
Ability to prioritize, multitask, and deliver high quality work in tight timeframes

new_jobs.title: Sourcing & Supply Chain Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
Job description summary

Responsible for day-to-day management of a technical project and to run this within the triple constraints described in the project plan. Responsible for the project supply chain deliverables, from project plan to final delivery, to realize its deliverables that will support the business case of the overall program.

Introduction to the job

As a Supply Chain and Sourcing manager within the ASML Strategic Sourcing and Procurement sector (SS&P), you will make a real difference by driving the end-to-end introduction and industrialization of ASML’s products from a Logistics, Cost, and Quality point-of-view, following ASML’s Product Generation Process (PGP). To achieve this, you will be using your unique mix of technical, creative, and people skills to lead and coordinate natural teams both at ASML and at suppliers.

Role and responsibilities (Final)

Define, secure and monitor the supply chain and sourcing NPI and industrialization deliverables in the {{b}}Product Generation Process{{/b}} (PGP) to successfully deliver volume-worthy products, including alignment on the SS&P sector’s KD decisions and driving D&E (Development&Engineering) deliverables.
{{b}}Identify and manage supply chain risks{{/b}}, acting as the voice of the suppliers within product teams. Conduct assessments on material availability, including supplier move-rate capabilities and long-leadtime item.
{{b}}Drive, monitor and report-out on Cost of Goods{{/b}} roadmap vs. target on Cluster in close collaboration with the SS&P clusters/commodities in Business Line and across SPFT’s/Supplier account teams.
Prepare yearly {{b}}OPEX/CAPEX{{/b}} forecast and manage spend within budget for Supplier NRE (Non-recurring expenses) and tooling&packaging, including monitoring throughout the year.
Proactively solve {{b}}QLTC{{/b}} (Quality, Logistics, Technology, Cost) in collaboration with internal (engineering and procurement/sourcing) and external stakeholders (suppliers) and organize periodic management reviews.
{{b}}Collaborate{{/b}} closely with cross-functional team (engineering, factory, field, suppliers) representatives in product teams to ensure alignment and integration of KD deliverables, together with a team of PLM Product Coordinators. Mobile resources if needed to fulfill the plans.
Apply {{b}}Early Supplier Involvement{{/b}} and Concurrent Engineering methodology to secure the required introduction timeline, including defining Complex Part List, and coordinating Make/Buy decisions and Supplier Selections w/the Supplier Account Teams.
Identify bottle necks, prepare decisions and take actions towards engineering, suppliers, factories as well as the field to {{b}}manage the critical path{{/b}} of new parts for time-to-market and ramp up.
{{b}}First point of contact{{/b}} for supply chain operations aspects and related issues in the cross-sector project cluster team and direct counterpart of the Module Delivery Unit (MDU)-lead.
{{b}}Report pro-actively{{/b}} on project status to relevant senior stakeholders, ensuring transparency and timely updates, including activities, milestones and resources.
{{b}}Represent SS&P in the AIR {{/b}}(ASML Issue Resolution){{b}} triage{{/b}}, managing AIR issues related to SS&P and End of Life/Supply.
{{b}}Drive continuous improvement initiatives{{/b}} within SS&P function to enhance efficiency and effectiveness

By fulfilling these responsibilities, you will play a crucial role in the successful industrialization and introduction of ASML’s cutting-edge product, ensuring that they meet the highest standards of quality, cost efficiency and performance.

Education and experience

Technical or Supply Chain Bachelor's degree required. Master's degree preferred.
A minimum of 6 years' relevant work-experience in a NPI environment preferably in a high-tech industry
Proven track record in project management and leading multi-disciplinary teams
Proven track record to improve efficiency and effectivity in technical production environment
Experience in interfacing with suppliers on industrialization targets preferred
Experience in out-of-the-box creative problem solving
Experience in bottleneck management of manufacturing processes
Previous sourcing experience highly preferred

Skills

Highly organized, capable to drive complex issues to simple and pragmatic solutions;
Influencing without formal authority, sense for tactical and political relations on both strategic and operational level;
Ability to establish and maintain effective relationships on different levels in the organization
Able to show resilience in a high stress, high pressure environment (e.g. escalations)
Conceptual and analytical thinker
Pragmatic, hands on and result driven mindset

new_jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Standardization
new_jobs.description:
Build the future, spark innovation and align your career with purpose.

McKinstry is innovating the waste and climate harm out of the built environment and creating lasting impact. Together, we’re building a thriving planet.

Buildings are a leading contributor to the climate crisis, generating nearly 40% of total global energy-related carbon emissions. We’re making a lasting impact on our industry and within our communities by addressing the climate, affordability and equity crises through:

renewables and energy services
engineering and design
construction and facility services

To get where we’re going, we need big thinkers, problem solvers and collaborative mindsets. Does that sound like you?

The Opportunity with McKinstry

McKinstry is looking for a Senior Program Manager, Standardization to join our Offsite Manufacturing division in Spokane, WA. The Senior Program Manager – Standardization leads the development, release, and adoption of the business processes that run the business unit and leads execution of the department's technology and business process improvement initiatives. The role's current top priority is leading implementation of Acumatica, the business unit's ERP system — building and maintaining the implementation schedule, providing status updates, and documenting the business process decisions made along the way — with the same playbook applied to future technology and process initiatives. Beyond named initiatives, the role focuses on business unit processes, especially those that cross functional boundaries where commercial, engineering, supply chain, operations, quality, project management, and finance must hand off work to one another. This role shapes how the business executes and drives development of documented, governed, repeatable standard work. Additional responsibilities may include:

Business Process Leadership

Own the process roadmap for the business unit, sequencing standardization work against live production commitments, growth targets, and customer program milestones.
Maintain the business unit’s process architecture: what processes exist, who owns each, how they connect, and where the gaps are.
Translate business objectives into standardization objectives and measures with leadership and report progress regularly.
Advise leaders on where standardization creates leverage and where flexibility should be intentionally preserved.
Initiative and Implementation Management
Lead the implementation of Acumatica (ERP), including building and maintaining the implementation schedule and providing regular status updates.
Apply the same implementation approach — schedule ownership, decision documentation, stakeholder alignment — to future technology and process improvement initiatives.
Organize and execute department business process improvement initiatives from scoping through completion.
Draft and propose OKRs for initiatives or execute against and report progress on OKRs set by leadership, depending on the initiative.
Source, select, and manage contractors and consultants supporting initiatives, owning scope, schedule, and budget for those engagements.

Cross-Functional Process Integration

Lead standardization of processes that span multiple functions, including order intake and contract-to-production handoff, engineering release and change control, procurement and long-lead material planning, production scheduling and capacity, quality and nonconformance, shipping and field integration, and warranty and closeout.
Define the inputs, outputs, ownership, and acceptance criteria at each functional handoff so work does not stall or degrade in the gaps between teams.
Resolve conflicting or duplicative practice between functions, escalating to leadership where process ownership is genuinely contested.
Embed processes into the systems of record – ERP, document control, quality management, and reporting – so process is reinforced by tooling rather than carried by individual experience.
Reconcile customer-specific commercial requirements with internal standard work so program obligations are met without one-off process.

Process Development and Release

Coordinate cross-functional teams through a standard development process to produce released, version-controlled deliverables.
Write and review policies, procedures, work instructions, and supporting documentation — including documenting the business process decisions made during initiative implementations — with process owners and subject matter experts.
Establish document control, revision, and approval conventions so processes are governed.

Change Management, Training, and Adoption

Develop implementation plans supporting communication, training, and sustained adoption of process deliverables.
Train project teams and operational leaders on the standard development process.
Communicate initiatives in small and large group settings, developing materials calibrated to mixed executive, commercial, engineering, operations, and craft audiences.

Team Leadership and Performance

Build process capability inside functional teams so ownership sits with the business, not solely with the program.
Track measures of process health: adoption and conformance, cycle time, rework and escape rates, audit findings, and other metrics as appropriate.
Route lessons learned back into the applicable processes.
No direct reports Day 1; may take on direct personnel management responsibility as the team grows.

Other duties as assigned.

What You Need To Succeed At McKinstry

Bachelor’s Degree required (industrial, mechanical, or manufacturing engineering, operations management, or supply chain preferred).
Minimum eight (8) years of team and/or project management experience required.
Demonstrated experience developing and deploying business process, standard work, or a quality management system across multiple functions in a manufacturing, industrialized construction, or offsite fabrication environment required.
Demonstrated ability to collaborate with and influence people at all levels across the organization required.
Excellent facilitation skills and the ability to lead diverse, cross-functional project teams required.
Ability to operate effectively in a high-growth environment where process and governance are authored in parallel with live production commitments.
Demonstrated experience managing scope, schedule, and budget for contractor or consulting engagements required.
Strongly Preferred: technical writing; engineer-to-order or high-mix production experience; ERP implementation experience (Acumatica preferred),, PLM, or document control systems; PMI certification; ISO 9001 or equivalent quality management system; LEAN Construction.

When it comes to the basics, we have you covered:

Competitive pay
401(k) with employer match and profit-sharing plan
Paid time off and holidays
Comprehensive medical, prescription, dental, and vision with low or zero deductible options and low out of pocket maximums

People come first at McKinstry, and we go beyond the basic benefits with:

Family formation benefits, including adoption and IVF assistance

Transgender inclusive benefits
Commuter benefits

McKinstry Moves onsite gyms or reimbursement for remote workers

See benefit plan documents for complete details.

If you’re driven by our vision to build a thriving planet together, McKinstry is the place to build your career.

Are you passionate about safety and ready to drive meaningful change at a global scale? Join our team as a Workplace, Health, and Safety (WHS) Program Manager and play a pivotal role in protecting the people who power Amazon's worldwide operations.

In this role, you'll serve as a trusted safety partner to senior regional and regional leaders, ensuring world-class safety standards for Information Technology (IT) team members across Amazon's global network. Through regular site visits, you'll stay closely connected to the daily realities of our frontline technicians — translating those insights into impactful regional and global safety programs.

You will own and drive safety programs from inception through implementation, lead rigorous incident investigations to uncover root causes, and develop corrective actions that prevent recurrence. Collaborating cross-functionally with Operations, Engineering, HR, and beyond, you'll scale successful safety initiatives and help cement Amazon's reputation as an industry safety leader.

Key job responsibilities

Own and drive safety programs from inception through global implementation, delivering measurable risk reduction outcomes across Amazon's worldwide network
Lead and manage safety-related projects end-to-end, defining clear actions, owners, and timelines to ensure successful delivery

Collaborate cross-functionally with teams in Operations, Engineering, HR, and beyond to scale successful safety initiatives and embed sustainable improvements

Your day might begin with check-in calls with regional leaders across Europe to discuss emerging issues and align on priorities. You'll then join a global project call to review a battery end-of-life management narrative with teammates worldwide. In the afternoon, you lead an incident investigation — reviewing footage, interviewing witnesses, and mapping root causes. You may also partner with field leaders on action plans, design safety features for new equipment, or close the day analyzing a global safety dashboard to prepare data-driven recommendations for senior leadership.

About The Team

The global WHS OpsTech Solutions team partners closely with Amazon's IT function, working to identify safety improvement opportunities by staying closely connected to the daily realities of our frontline technicians and end users. We collaborate cross-functionally to create policies, drive standardization, and enhance hardware — all with the goal of continuously improving procedural safety across the organization. By remaining grounded in the experiences of our workforce, we develop targeted solutions that protect our people and empower them to work safely. Experience in written and spoken English and an ability to compose grammatically correct, concise and accurate written responses

Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) Fluency

new_jobs.title: Operations Research Analyst, Mission Engineering
new_jobs.description:
CHAOS Industries is redefining modern defense with a multi-product portfolio that gives the ultimate advantage—domain dominance. The company's products are powered by Coherent Distributed Networks (CDN™), empowering warfighters, commercial air operators, and border protection teams to act faster, adapt rapidly, and stay ahead of evolving threats.

CHAOS Industries was founded in 2022 and has raised a total of $1 billion in funding from leading investors, including 8VC, Accel, and Valor Equity Partners. The company is headquartered in Los Angeles, with offices in Washington, D.C., San Francisco, San Diego, Seattle, and London. For more information, please visit www.chaosinc.com.

About the Team:
Mission Engineering at CHAOS turns simulation output into decisions. We run large-scale modeling and simulation campaigns across all warfighting domains and the full kill chain, against named threats, in operationally relevant scenarios, at the speed engineering, operational, and customer teams actually need. Every CHAOS engineering trade, pursuit, and customer engagement is anchored in rigorous, physics-based, tactically relevant, and statistically valid analysis, and we're scaling the function to meet that bar across a growing product portfolio.

About the Role:
On the Mission Engineering team at CHAOS, you will design, develop, execute, analyze, and validate models and simulations to deliver operational analysis and system performance assessment across defense, national security, and commercial programs. You will have freedom to move rapidly and use your expertise to apply rigorous statistical methods to analyze simulation outcomes, quantify system effectiveness, and communicate actionable insights to technical teams, leadership, and customers. Your work will directly inform critical decisions around sensor performance, mission planning, weapon effectiveness, and platform capability evaluation.

This is a foundational hire. You will shape how CHAOS does mission analysis from day one, and you will have the freedom to move fast.

What You'll Do

Scope, plan, and execute modeling and simulation efforts and studies aligned to program objectives, managing your competing priorities and timelines effectively.
Develop, configure, and execute analysis using mission-level models and simulations such as AFSIM, ESAMS, Brawler, Ansys STK, and/or physics-based models to evaluate system and platform performance in operationally relevant scenarios.
Build and refine models of sensors, communications systems, aircraft (including unmanned), weapons, and spacecraft within mission-level simulation frameworks.
Architect, implement, and validate models of both blue and red systems, sensors, communications, weapons, aircraft, spacecraft, and ground/maritime platforms, within mission- and engagement-level simulation frameworks.
Define and apply rigorous statistical methodologies to simulation results to quantify measures of effectiveness and performance to produce relevant and defensible findings for internal and external stakeholders.
Develop and maintain Python-based analysis tools and pipelines for data processing, statistical analysis, and visualization.
Implement technical methodology, simulation best practices, and customer engagement.
Document methodology, assumptions, and findings in technical reports and briefing materials, including data visualizations, and present results to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Partner with engineering, product, growth, and customer teams to translate operational questions into well-structured analytical approaches and shape new business pursuits. Push back when the framing is wrong.

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Aerospace/Software/Computer Engineering, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Operations Research, Physics, or a related field.
5+ years of experience supporting defense, intelligence, or advanced technology programs through industry or government employment.
Demonstrated track record leading mission-level operations analysis studies and delivering decision-quality results to senior engineering and customer stakeholders.
Extensive direct experience with combat simulations such as AFSIM, ESAMS, Brawler, Ansys STK, or equivalent, including ownership of rigorous methodology, not just execution.
Significant experience developing analytical tools and applying rigorous statistical methods to interpret and present results.
Strong proficiency in Python and MATLAB, including standard scientific computing libraries (such as Pandas, Polars, NumPy, SciPy, Scikit-Learn, Matplotlib, Seaborn, CuPy, or PyTorch).
Exceptional data visualization skills and comfort developing CONOPS/OV-1 visuals and briefing packages.
Proficiency with software development practices including version control and leveraging/validating outputs of AI-assisted coding tools.
Demonstrated ability to lead analytical efforts and deliver products with minimal oversight, including leading projects and studies.
Comfortable working on Linux-based systems and writing scalable scripts and software.
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including experience briefing flag/general officer or SES-level audiences.
Eligibility to obtain a Top Secret / Sensitive Compartmented Information (TS/SCI) clearance

Preferred Requirements

Active TS/SCI clearance.
Recognized expertise analyzing the full kill chain (find, fix, track, target, engage, assess) across multiple domains, including air-to-air, air-to-surface, surface-to-air, space, and electronic warfare engagements.
Deep expertise in sensor performance analysis (especially radar) and in developing and validating models of sensors, communications, weapons, aircraft, spacecraft, or ground/maritime systems in mission-level simulation environments such as AFSIM or Ansys STK.
Experience leading study teams or technical working groups across organizations, including model accreditation, V&V efforts, or threat-informed scenario development.
Experience designing and analyzing large-scale Monte Carlo and DOE-driven simulation campaigns supporting system effectiveness or kill chain assessment.
Exposure to Distributed Interactive Simulation (DIS) networking and visualization tools such as MAK VR-Forces, SIMDIS, or similar.
Experience supporting rapid development programs across DoD services, DARPA, ONR, AFRL, COCOMs, the acquisition community, or commercial advanced technology programs.
Experience supporting capture and positioning activities (RFI/RFP responses, white papers, technical exchanges) and shaping new business pursuits.

Why CHAOS?

Health Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision benefits 100% paid for by the company
Additional benefits: 401k (+ 50% company match up to 6% of pay), FSA, HSA, life insurance, and more
Our Perks: Free daily lunch, ‘No meeting Fridays’, unlimited PTO, casual dress code
Compensation Components: Competitive base salaries, generous pre-IPO stock option grants, relocation assistance, and (coming soon!) annual bonuses
Team Growth: 250 employees and counting across 5 global offices

Salary Range: $123,000 - 169,000

If your compensation requirements fall outside of the range, we still encourage you to apply.
