Description

Space Operation Staff Analyst

The successful candidate will support the Combined Forces Space Component Command (CFSCC) located at Vandenberg Space Force Base, CA (VSFB). You will have an exciting and important role joining a small team of experts providing operational-level advice to Command Leaders, supporting the development of military space operations plans and policies. This team helps to ensure unity-of-effort in space operations support to theater warfighters, US government and civil agencies, and commercial and foreign partners. In support of this Space Command warfighting organization, you will routinely interface with HQ United States Space Command (USSPACECOM), other USSPACECOM Components, Combatant Commands, assigned and attached subordinate units, Civil and Department of Defense (DoD) agencies, Coalition Partners, and others as necessary to facilitate the execution of missions and tasks. You will conduct international and domestic trips to coordinate planning efforts to strengthen collaboration and ensure alignment across all nations participating in Multi-National Forces – Operation OLYMPIC DEFENDER (MNF-OOD).

Technical support includes, but is not limited to, the following areas S4S S35, Future Operations and S4S S38, Integration Space Situational Awareness (SSA) sharing information, Space Domain Awareness (SDA), technical studies, and analyses; operations concept development; operations planning and support; evaluation of operations procedures, capabilities, and requirements; validation and verification activities; and program administrative, security, documentation, and presentation support. You will attend appropriate planning and development forums and technical interchange meetings to further understand the background and basis for developing technical analyses.

Travel is anticipated – approximately five one-week trips per year which may include international travel.

Plan, analyze, and assess Command and Control, SDA, SSA sharing and space control concepts, architectures, plans, policies, doctrine, and requirements.
Provide analytical and administrative support to, and/or products and documents for, combined/joint space operations planning consistent with Joint Publication 5.0, Joint Planning.
Analyze technical capabilities, mission objectives, and available resources to develop strategies, policy, and guidance, Concepts of Operations (CONOPS), alternatives and recommended solutions to achieve and/or optimize specific desired space operations goals and objectives to ensure CFSCC operations are positioned to support and anticipate end user needs (i.e. doctrine, organization, training, materiel, leadership and education, personnel and facilities).
Review, analyze, coordinate, recommend revisions to, and draft coordination of, space operations documents including Directives, Instructions, CONOPS, Agreements, Requirements, and other documents as required and provide knowledge management support for CFSCC operations and staff data, etc.
Provide analysis of potential impacts to the CFSCC missions and corresponding operations centers operations including global sensor issues, space events, and US and foreign space policy impacts.
Support resolution of anomalous events and USG or international policy changes that impact space operations.
Provide administrative and analytical support for the conduct of Commander Priorities, Readiness, Operations and other Assessments including analyzing and recommending revisions to ensure alignment with applicable orders/missions.
Provide analytical and administrative support at technical meetings to accomplish task requirements including working groups such as Lessons Learned and Rules of Engagement.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

Active Top Secret clearance at time of application with SCI eligibility.
Bachelor's degree with 5-10 years of relevant experience.
Experience providing decision support among diverse agencies, customers, and stakeholders (e.g., commercial, civil, governmental partners).
Demonstrated proficiency in conveying operational capabilities, limitations, employment needs and requirements through customer-desired products and forums.
Familiarity with space operations in context of joint operations.
Knowledge of varying types of military doctrine to include orders, plans, policies, instructions, and concepts of operations.
Ability to research various sources of information and compile concisely into presentations, information papers, briefings, etc.
Ability to obtain a U.S. Passport.

Desired Qualifications

Prior military experience.
Experience with military operations, planning, and policies.
Experience in space operations, joint operations and working with operational centers and international partners.
Knowledge of Joint Publication 3-14 Space Operations; Joint Publication 5-0, Joint Planning.
Knowledge of the Space Surveillance Network, Space Domain Awareness, SATCOM, Missile Warning/Defense, Global Sensor Management, Electromagnetic Interference, and Space Control.

Your goal is to keep DFX deliverables on track to program milestones, surface risks early, and ensure smooth execution from first silicon through production ramp.

Work closely with DFX engineering managers and engineers, as well as cross-functional partners in silicon design, physical design, verification, post-silicon validation, test engineering, operations and software, to drive DFX execution across multiple concurrent programs.
Own the integrated DFX execution schedule for assigned programs from plan of record through production release, tracking dependencies and deliverables against key milestones including tapeout, first silicon, bring-up, qualification and release

About The Company

Cynet Systems Inc. was founded in 2010 and is headquartered in the Washington, DC metro area. The company is a technology staffing and workforce solutions provider serving Fortune 500 companies, government agencies, and enterprise organizations across the United States and Canada. Cynet Systems delivers agile, scalable talent solutions across IT, engineering, life sciences, clinical, and professional staffing, supported by a recruitment network operating across North America and Asia. As a nationally and locally certified Minority Business Enterprise (MBE), Cynet Systems is committed to helping organizations build high-performing teams and supporting professionals as they grow rewarding careers. Its ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 27001, and SOC 2 Type II certifications reflect a commitment to quality, security, operational excellence, and customer success.

About The Role

Cynet Systems is seeking an experienced Business Consultant to join the Operations Project Management Office (OPMO). This highly visible position reports to the Director of Project Management and supports projects led by or delivered in partnership with the Operations organization. The consultant will coordinate, plan, and develop business analysis and requirements documentation for a large-scale initiative to implement Salesforce across Operations, as well as related business readiness activities. Success in this role depends on strong communication and collaboration across Operations business units and with technology teams, suppliers, and procurement partners. Experience with Salesforce business or technical components is highly desirable. The pay range for this position is $57.06 to $62.06 per hour.

Qualifications

Candidates should have at least five years of related business analysis experience and a record of contributing to medium- to large-scale projects. The ideal candidate can apply sound judgment to complex business and systems challenges, work independently on most issues, and seek guidance when project complexity calls for it. Experience with requirements management, business process analysis, impact assessment, and organizational readiness is important. Applicants should demonstrate clear, concise written and verbal communication skills and the ability to facilitate productive requirements-gathering sessions. The successful candidate will collaborate effectively with business and systems experts, negotiate and influence requirements decisions, conduct peer reviews, and help ensure the quality of project deliverables. Salesforce experience is a strong advantage.

Responsibilities

Define business and systems scope and objectives by assessing user needs, industry requirements, and organizational priorities. Analyze business and user needs, document functional and non-functional requirements, and translate findings into clear business or systems requirements. Plan requirements management for medium- to large-scale projects and lead analysis across multiple parallel initiatives, including business impact assessments. Develop process models, process outlines, procedures, and job aids that support implementation and prepare teams for change.

Assess complex problems and recommend workable procedures that account for business and system limitations, operating timelines, and desired outcomes. Identify process and procedural gaps, evaluate risks, and develop practical recommendations that advance business value and process improvement. Lead initiatives aligned with business strategy, anticipate changing needs, and redirect efforts when priorities shift. Facilitate meetings with stakeholders and business partners, build relationships across the organization and vendor network, and communicate difficult decisions clearly and promptly. Drive escalation analysis and resolution on complex issues, apply critical thinking to recommendations, guide less-experienced Business Analysts, and provide oversight of work quality.

Benefits

Benefits may include medical, dental, and vision insurance; a 401(k) retirement plan; a Health Savings Account (HSA); short- and long-term disability insurance; life and AD&D insurance; and supplemental insurance plans. Additional offerings may include paid sick leave where required by law, identity theft protection, pet insurance, employee wellness programs, an Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and career growth and professional development opportunities. Eligibility, accrual rates, and usage limits may vary according to employment status, length of service, and work location. Paid sick leave is provided in accordance with applicable state and municipal requirements. Cynet Systems reserves the right to modify, amend, or terminate benefit plans in accordance with applicable laws.

Equal Opportunity

Cynet Systems is committed to providing equal employment opportunities and fostering a respectful, inclusive workplace. Employment decisions are made without discrimination based on any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. The company encourages qualified candidates from diverse backgrounds to apply.
